#[local] Transparent itype۰array array٠unsafe_faa array٠sum array۰model.

Section zoo۰G.
  Context `{zoo۰G : !ZooG Σ}.

  Lemma array٠unsafe_faaｰtype t (sz : nat) (i : Z) (incr : Z) :
    (0 ≤ i < sz)%Z →
    {{{
      itype۰array itype۰int sz t
    }}}
      array٠unsafe_faa t #i #incr
    {{{
      (n : Z)
    , RET #n;
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hi %Φ (%l & -> & #Hheader & #Htype) HΦ".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    Z_to_nat i.

    iInv "Htype" as "(%vs & >%Hvs & >Hmodel & >#Hvs)".
    destruct (lookup_lt_is_Some_2 vs i) as (v & Hlookup); first lia.
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup with "Hvs") as "Hv"; first done.
    iDestruct "Hv" as "(%n & ->)".
    iDestruct (chunk۰modelｰupdate i with "Hmodel") as "(H↦ & Hmodel)"; [lia | done | lia |].
    wp۰faa.
    iSplitR "HΦ"; last iSteps.
    iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Hvs") as "(_ & Hvs')"; first done.
    iExists (<[i := #(n + incr)]> vs). simp_length.
    iSplitR. { done. }
    iSplitL "H↦ Hmodel". { iApply ("Hmodel" with "H↦"). }
    iApply "Hvs'". iSteps.
  Qed.

  Lemma array٠sumｰtype t sz :
    {{{
      itype۰array itype۰int sz t
    }}}
      array٠sum t
    {{{
      (n : Z)
    , RET #n;
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ #Htype HΦ".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (array٠foldlｰtype itype۰int itype۰int with "[$Htype]") as (acc) "Hacc".
    { iSteps. }
    iDestruct "Hacc" as "(%n & ->)".
    iSteps.
  Qed.

  Lemma array۰modelｰloc t dq vs :
    array۰model t dq vs ⊢
    ⌜∃ l : location, t = #l⌝.
  Proof.
    iIntros "(%l & -> & _)". iSteps.
  Qed.
End zoo۰G.

Fixpoint bucket۰to_val (bucket : list (val * val)) :=
  match bucket with
  | [] =>
      §htbl٠bucket٠Nil%V
  | (key, v) :: bucket =>
      ‘htbl٠bucket٠Cons[ key, v, bucket۰to_val bucket ]%V
  end.
#[global] Arguments bucket۰to_val !_ / : assert.

#[global] Instance bucket۰to_valｰinj :
  Inj (=) (=) bucket۰to_val.
Proof.
  intros bucket1. induction bucket1 as [| (key1, v1) bucket1 IH]; intros [| (key2, v2) bucket2]; try done.
  intros [= -> -> ->%IH]. done.
Qed.
Lemma bucket۰to_valｰsimilar bucket1 bucket2 :
  bucket۰to_val bucket1 ≈ bucket۰to_val bucket2 →
  bucket1 = bucket2.
Proof.
  destruct bucket1 as [| (key1, v1) bucket1], bucket2 as [| (key2, v2) bucket2]; try done.
  intros (_ & _ & [= -> -> ->%(inj _)]). done.
Qed.


Definition is_pow2 (n : nat) :=
  ∃ k, n = 2 ^ k.

Lemma is_pow2ｰpos n :
  is_pow2 n →
  0 < n.
Proof.
  intros (k & ->). apply Nat.neq_0_lt_0, Nat.pow_nonzero. done.
Qed.
Lemma is_pow2ｰdouble n :
  is_pow2 n →
  is_pow2 (2 * n).
Proof.
  intros (k & ->). exists (S k). done.
Qed.
Lemma is_pow2ｰhalf n :
  is_pow2 n →
  1 < n →
  is_pow2 (n / 2) ∧ n = 2 * (n / 2).
Proof.
  intros (k & ->) Hn.
  destruct k as [| k]; first (simpl in Hn; lia).
  rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' (Nat.mul_comm 2) Nat.div_mul //.
  split; first by exists k. lia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_of_nat_pow2 k :
  ⁺(2 ^ k) = (2 ^ ⁺k)%Z.
Proof.
  rewrite Nat2Z.inj_pow //.
Qed.

Lemma Z_mod_mul_r (a b c : Z) :
  (0 < b)%Z →
  (0 < c)%Z →
  (a `mod` (b * c) = a `mod` b + b * ((a `div` b) `mod` c))%Z.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hc.
  symmetry. apply Z.mod_unique with (Z.div (Z.div a b) c).
  - pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound a b Hb).
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound (Z.div a b) c Hc).
    left. nia.
  - pose proof (Z.div_mod a b ltac:(lia)) as H1.
    pose proof (Z.div_mod (Z.div a b) c ltac:(lia)) as H2.
    set q := Z.div a b in H1 H2 |- *.
    set q' := Z.div q c in H2 |- *.
    set r := Z.modulo q c in H2 |- *.
    nia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_land_pow2_pred (h : Z) (n : nat) :
  is_pow2 n →
  (Z.land h (⁺n - 1) = h `mod` ⁺n)%Z.
Proof.
  intros (k & ->).
  rewrite Z_of_nat_pow2 -Z.land_ones; first lia.
  rewrite Z.ones_equiv. f_equal; lia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_land_pow2 (h : Z) (n : nat) :
  is_pow2 n →
  (Z.land h ⁺n = ⁺n * Z.b2z (Z.testbit h (Z.log2 ⁺n)))%Z.
Proof.
  intros (k & ->).
  rewrite Z_of_nat_pow2 Z.log2_pow2; first lia.
  apply Z.bits_inj'. intros m Hm.
  rewrite Z.land_spec Z.pow2_bits_eqb; first lia.
  destruct (Z.testbit h ⁺k) eqn:Hb => /=.
  - rewrite Z.mul_1_r Z.pow2_bits_eqb; first lia.
    destruct (Z.eqb_spec ⁺k m) as [<- |]; first rewrite Hb //.
    rewrite andb_false_r //.
  - rewrite Z.mul_0_r Z.bits_0.
    destruct (Z.eqb_spec ⁺k m) as [<- |]; first rewrite Hb //.
    rewrite andb_false_r //.
Qed.

Lemma Z_mod_pow2_double (h : Z) (n : nat) :
  is_pow2 n →
  (h `mod` ⁺(2 * n) = h `mod` ⁺n + ⁺n * Z.b2z (Z.testbit h (Z.log2 ⁺n)))%Z.
Proof.
  intros Hn. pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hn).
  destruct Hn as (k & ->).
  rewrite Nat2Z.inj_mul Z_of_nat_pow2 Z.log2_pow2; first lia.
  rewrite (Z.mul_comm 2) Z_mod_mul_r; [lia.. |].
  rewrite Z.testbit_spec' //; lia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_mod_pow2_half (h : Z) (n : nat) :
  is_pow2 n →
  ((h `mod` ⁺(2 * n)) `mod` ⁺n = h `mod` ⁺n)%Z.
Proof.
  intros Hn. pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hn).
  rewrite Nat2Z.inj_mul Z.mul_comm Z_mod_mul_r; [lia.. |].
  rewrite Z.add_mod; first lia.
  rewrite Z.mod_mod; first lia.
  rewrite (Z.mul_comm ⁺n) Z.mod_mul; first lia.
  rewrite Z.add_0_r Z.mod_mod //. lia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_mod_pow2_double_cases (h : Z) (n : nat) :
  is_pow2 n →
  (h `mod` ⁺(2 * n) = h `mod` ⁺n ∨
   h `mod` ⁺(2 * n) = h `mod` ⁺n + ⁺n)%Z.
Proof.
  intros Hn.
  rewrite Z_mod_pow2_double //.
  destruct (Z.testbit _ _); simpl; [right | left]; lia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_gcd_pow2_odd (n : nat) (step : Z) :
  is_pow2 n →
  Z.Odd step →
  Z.gcd ⁺n step = 1%Z.
Proof.
  intros (k & ->) (r & Hr).
  rewrite Z_of_nat_pow2.
  apply Z.coprime_pow_l; first lia.
  apply Z.coprime_mod_r_iff.
  replace (step `mod` 2)%Z with 1%Z; first apply Z.coprime_1_r.
  apply Z.mod_unique with r; [left; lia | lia].
Qed.

Lemma Z_mod_eq_divide (a b c : Z) :
  (0 < c)%Z →
  (a `mod` c = b `mod` c)%Z →
  (c | a - b)%Z.
Proof.
  intros Hc Hab.
  exists (Z.div a c - Z.div b c)%Z.
  pose proof (Z.div_mod a c ltac:(lia)).
  pose proof (Z.div_mod b c ltac:(lia)).
  nia.
Qed.

Lemma Z_coverage (n : nat) (step : Z) (m : nat) :
  is_pow2 n →
  Z.Odd step →
  1 ≤ m →
  ((⁺m * step) `mod` ⁺n = 0)%Z →
  ∀ j,
  (0 ≤ j < ⁺n)%Z →
  ∃ a,
  1 ≤ a ≤ m ∧
  ((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺n = j)%Z.
Proof.
  intros Hn Hstep Hm Hmn j Hj.
  pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hn).
  pose proof (Z_gcd_pow2_odd _ _ Hn Hstep) as Hgcd.
  assert (n ≤ m) as Hnm.
  { apply (Z.mod_divide _ ⁺n ltac:(lia)) in Hmn.
    rewrite Z.mul_comm in Hmn.
    pose proof (Z.gauss _ _ _ Hmn Hgcd) as Hdiv.
    apply Z.divide_pos_le in Hdiv; lia.
  }
  pose f (a : nat) := ((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺n)%Z.
  assert (NoDup (f <$> seq 1 n)) as Hl.
  { apply NoDup_fmap_2_strong; last apply NoDup_seq.
    intros a1 a2 (? & ?)%elem_of_seq (? & ?)%elem_of_seq Ha.
    apply (Z_mod_eq_divide _ _ ⁺n ltac:(lia)) in Ha.
    rewrite -Z.mul_sub_distr_r Z.mul_comm in Ha.
    pose proof (Z.gauss _ _ _ Ha Hgcd) as Hdiv.
    destruct (decide (a1 = a2)); first done.
    destruct (Z.le_gt_cases ⁺a2 ⁺a1).
    + apply Z.divide_pos_le in Hdiv; lia.
    + apply Z.divide_opp_r, Z.divide_pos_le in Hdiv; lia.
  }
  assert (List.incl (seqZ 0 ⁺n) (f <$> seq 1 n)) as Hincl.
  { apply NoDup_length_incl.
    - apply NoDup_ListNoDup. done.
    - rewrite length_fmap length_seq length_seqZ. lia.
    - intros x (a & -> & _)%list_elem_of_In%list_elem_of_fmap.
      apply list_elem_of_In, elem_of_seqZ.
      split; [apply Z.mod_pos_bound | apply Z.mod_pos_bound]; lia.
  }
  opose proof* (Hincl j) as Hj'.
  { apply list_elem_of_In, elem_of_seqZ. lia. }
  apply list_elem_of_In, list_elem_of_fmap in Hj' as (a & -> & (? & ?)%elem_of_seq).
  exists a. split; [lia | done].
Qed.


Section entries.
  Context {Key : Type} `{Countable Key}.

  Implicit Type 𝑘𝑒𝑦 : Key.
  Implicit Type 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 : Key → Z.
  Implicit Type e : val * val * Key.
  Implicit Type es : list (val * val * Key).

  Fixpoint entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es : option val :=
    match es with
    | [] =>
        None
    | (_, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦') :: es =>
        if decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦') then Some v else entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es
    end.

  Lemma entries۰lookupｰNone 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es :
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es = None ↔
    𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∉ es.*2.
  Proof.
    induction es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es IH]; first set_solver.
    rewrite /= elem_of_cons. case_decide; naive.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰lookupｰSome 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es v :
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es = Some v →
    ∃ key,
    (key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ∈ es.
  Proof.
    induction es as [| ((key, w), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es IH]; first done.
    rewrite /=. case_decide as Hkey.
    - intros [= ->]. subst. exists key. set_solver.
    - intros (key' & ?)%IH. exists key'. set_solver.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰lookupｰSomeｰNoDup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es key v :
    NoDup es.*2 →
    (key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ∈ es →
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es = Some v.
  Proof.
    induction es as [| ((key', w), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es IH]; first set_solver.
    rewrite fmap_cons NoDup_cons elem_of_cons /=.
    intros (Hnotin & Hnodup) [[= -> -> ->] | Hin].
    - rewrite decide_True //.
    - rewrite decide_False; last auto.
      intros ->. apply Hnotin, list_elem_of_fmap. exists (key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦'). done.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰lookupｰapp 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es1 es2 :
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (es1 ++ es2) =
      match entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es1 with
      | Some v =>
          Some v
      | None =>
          entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es2
      end.
  Proof.
    induction es1 as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es1 IH]; first done.
    rewrite /=. case_decide; done.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰lookupｰfilter 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (P : val * val * Key → Prop) `{!∀ e, Decision (P e)} es :
    (∀ e, e ∈ es → e.2 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦 → P e) →
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (filter P es) = entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es.
  Proof.
    induction es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es IH]; first done.
    intros HP.
    rewrite filter_cons /=.
    case_decide as HP'.
    - rewrite /=. case_decide; first done.
      apply IH. set_solver.
    - rewrite decide_False.
      { intros ->. apply HP', HP; set_solver. }
      apply IH. set_solver.
  Qed.

  Definition entries۰encode es : list (val * val * positive) :=
    (λ e, (e.1, encode e.2)) <$> es.

  #[global] Instance entries۰encodeｰinj :
    Inj (=) (=) entries۰encode.
  Proof.
    intros es1 es2 Heq.
    assert (Inj (=) (=) (λ e : val * val * Key, (e.1, encode e.2))) as Hinj.
    { intros ((key1, v1), 𝑘𝑒𝑦1) ((key2, v2), 𝑘𝑒𝑦2) [= -> -> ->%(inj _)]. done. }
    apply (inj (fmap (M := list) (λ e : val * val * Key, (e.1, encode e.2)))) in Heq. done.
  Qed.

  Definition entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (cap : nat) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 : nat :=
    ₊(𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦 `mod` ⁺cap).

  Lemma entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    0 < cap →
    entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 < cap.
  Proof.
    intros Hcap.
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ⁺cap ltac:(lia)).
    rewrite /entries۰index. lia.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰indexｰZ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    0 < cap →
    ⁺(entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦) = (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦 `mod` ⁺cap)%Z.
  Proof.
    intros Hcap.
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ⁺cap ltac:(lia)).
    rewrite /entries۰index. lia.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰indexｰdouble 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    is_pow2 cap →
    entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (2 * cap) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 =
    entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 + (if bool_decide (Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ⁺cap = ⁺cap) then cap else 0).
  Proof.
    intros Hcap. pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hcap).
    apply Nat2Z.inj.
    rewrite Nat2Z.inj_add entries۰indexｰZ; first lia.
    rewrite entries۰indexｰZ; first lia.
    rewrite Z_mod_pow2_double // Z_land_pow2 //.
    destruct (Z.testbit _ _) => /=.
    - rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2; lia.
    - rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2; lia.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰indexｰhalf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    is_pow2 cap →
    entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (2 * cap) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 `mod` cap = entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
  Proof.
    intros Hcap. pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hcap).
    rewrite entries۰indexｰdouble //.
    pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ltac:(lia)).
    case_bool_decide.
    - rewrite -{2}(Nat.mul_1_l cap) Nat.Div0.mod_add Nat.mod_small //.
    - rewrite Nat.add_0_r Nat.mod_small //.
  Qed.
  Lemma entries۰indexｰland 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    is_pow2 cap →
    Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ⁺cap = 0%Z ∨
    Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ⁺cap = ⁺cap.
  Proof.
    intros Hcap.
    rewrite Z_land_pow2 //.
    destruct (Z.testbit _ _); [right | left]; simpl; lia.
  Qed.

  Definition entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es :=
    Forall (λ e, entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap e.2 = i) es ∧
    NoDup es.*2.

  Lemma entries۰wfｰlookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es →
    entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ≠ i →
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es = None.
  Proof.
    intros (Hes & _) Hi.
    apply entries۰lookupｰNone.
    intros ((key, v) & -> & Hin)%list_elem_of_fmap.
    rewrite Forall_forall in Hes. apply Hi, (Hes _ Hin).
  Qed.

  Inductive cell :=
    | CellInit
    | CellActive es
    | CellFrozen es.
  Implicit Type c : cell.
  Implicit Type cs : list cell.

  #[global] Instance cellｰinhabited :
    Inhabited cell.
  Proof.
    exact (populate CellInit).
  Qed.

  Definition cell۰entries c :=
    match c with
    | CellInit =>
        []
    | CellActive es
    | CellFrozen es =>
        es
    end.

  Definition cell۰to_val c :=
    match c with
    | CellInit =>
        §htbl٠bucket٠Init%V
    | CellActive es =>
        bucket۰to_val es.*1
    | CellFrozen es =>
        ‘htbl٠bucket٠Resize( bucket۰to_val es.*1 )%V
    end.

  Lemma cellｰinitｰcases c :
    c = CellInit ∨ c ≠ CellInit.
  Proof.
    destruct c; [left | right..]; done.
  Qed.

  Definition cell۰is_frozen c :=
    ∃ es, c = CellFrozen es.
  Definition cell۰is_active c :=
    ∃ es, c = CellActive es.

  Definition cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs :=
    ∀ i c,
    cs !! i = Some c →
    entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) i (cell۰entries c).

  Definition cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :=
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (cell۰entries (cs !!! entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) 𝑘𝑒𝑦)).

  Definition split۰entries 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (cap : nat) (hi : bool) es :=
    filter (λ e, Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 e.2) ⁺cap = if hi then ⁺cap else 0%Z) es.

  Definition cells۰pending۰split 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs j c' :=
    c' = CellInit ∨
    ∃ es,
    cs !! (j `mod` length cs) = Some (CellFrozen es) ∧
    c' = CellActive (split۰entries 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) (bool_decide (length cs ≤ j)) es).
  Definition cells۰pending۰merge cs cap' j c' :=
    c' = CellInit ∨
    ∃ es1 es2,
    cs !! j = Some (CellFrozen es1) ∧
    cs !! (j + cap') = Some (CellFrozen es2) ∧
    c' = CellActive (es2 ++ es1).
  Definition cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' :=
    ( length cs' = 2 * length cs ∧
      ∀ j c',
      cs' !! j = Some c' →
      cells۰pending۰split 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs j c'
    ) ∨ (
      length cs = 2 * length cs' ∧
      ∀ j c',
      cs' !! j = Some c' →
      cells۰pending۰merge cs (length cs') j c'
    ).

  Lemma entries۰wfｰsublist 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es1 es2 :
    es1 `sublist_of` es2 →
    entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es2 →
    entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es1.
  Proof.
    intros Hsub (Hes2 & Hnodup). split.
    - rewrite Forall_forall in Hes2.
      apply Forall_forall. intros e He.
      apply Hes2, (elem_of_sublist _ _ _ He Hsub).
    - apply (sublist_NoDup _ es2.*2); first done.
      apply fmap_sublist. done.
  Qed.

  Lemma entries۰lookupｰdelete 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es k :
    NoDup es.*2 →
    es.*2 !! k = Some 𝑘𝑒𝑦 →
    ∀ 𝑘𝑒𝑦',
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦' (delete k es) =
      if decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦' = 𝑘𝑒𝑦) then None else entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦' es.
  Proof.
    revert k. induction es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦'') es IH]; first done.
    intros [| k] Hnodup Hlookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦'; rewrite fmap_cons NoDup_cons in Hnodup; destruct Hnodup as (Hnotin & Hnodup).
    - injection Hlookup as ->. rewrite /=.
      case_decide as Heq; last done.
      subst. apply entries۰lookupｰNone. done.
    - rewrite /= IH //.
      case_decide as Heq1; case_decide as Heq2; try done; subst.
      exfalso. apply Hnotin, list_elem_of_lookup_2 with k. done.
  Qed.

  Lemma cells۰lookupｰinsert 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs i c 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    i < length cs →
    cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (<[i := c]> cs) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 =
      if decide (entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = i) then
        entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (cell۰entries c)
      else
        cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
  Proof.
    intros Hi.
    rewrite /cells۰lookup length_insert.
    case_decide as Heq.
    - rewrite Heq list_lookup_total_insert decide_True //.
    - rewrite list_lookup_total_insert_ne //.
  Qed.

  Lemma cells۰wfｰinsert 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs i c :
    entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) i (cell۰entries c) →
    cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs →
    cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (<[i := c]> cs).
  Proof.
    intros Hc Hcs j c'.
    rewrite length_insert list_lookup_insert_Some.
    intros [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup)]; first done.
    apply Hcs. done.
  Qed.

  Lemma cells۰pendingｰwf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' :
    is_pow2 (length cs) →
    is_pow2 (length cs') →
    cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs →
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' →
    cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs'.
  Proof.
    intros Hcap Hcap' Hcs [(Hlen & Hpending) | (Hlen & Hpending)] j c' Hlookup;
      opose proof* (Hpending j c') as [-> | Hc']; try done;
      try (split; [apply Forall_nil | apply NoDup_nil]; done).
    all: pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hcap).
    all: pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hcap').
    all: pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hlookup).
    - destruct Hc' as (es & Hes & ->).
      opose proof* (Hcs (j `mod` length cs)) as (Hes1 & Hes2); first done.
      split; last first.
      { apply (sublist_NoDup _ es.*2); first done.
        apply fmap_sublist, sublist_filter.
      }
      rewrite /= /split۰entries Forall_forall.
      rewrite Forall_forall in Hes1.
      intros e (Hland & He)%list_elem_of_filter.
      opose proof* (Hes1 e He) as Hindex.
      rewrite Hlen entries۰indexｰdouble // Hindex.
      case_bool_decide as Hj.
      + rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2 //.
        assert (j `div` length cs = 1) as Hdiv by (symmetry; apply Nat.div_unique with (j - length cs); lia).
        pose proof (Nat.div_mod j (length cs) ltac:(lia)). lia.
      + rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2; first lia.
        rewrite Nat.add_0_r Nat.mod_small //. lia.
    - destruct Hc' as (es1 & es2 & Hes1 & Hes2 & ->).
      opose proof* (Hcs j) as (Hes1_1 & Hes1_2); first done.
      opose proof* (Hcs (j + length cs')) as (Hes2_1 & Hes2_2); first done.
      rewrite Hlen /= in Hes1_1 Hes2_1.
      rewrite Forall_forall in Hes1_1.
      rewrite Forall_forall in Hes2_1.
      split.
      + rewrite /= Forall_app !Forall_forall. split.
        * intros e He.
          rewrite -entries۰indexｰhalf // (Hes2_1 _ He).
          rewrite -{1}(Nat.mul_1_l (length cs')) Nat.Div0.mod_add Nat.mod_small //.
        * intros e He.
          rewrite -entries۰indexｰhalf // (Hes1_1 _ He) Nat.mod_small //.
      + rewrite /= fmap_app NoDup_app. split_and!; try done.
        intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (e2 & -> & He2)%list_elem_of_fmap (e1 & Heq & He1)%list_elem_of_fmap.
        opose proof* (Hes1_1 _ He1) as Hi1.
        opose proof* (Hes2_1 _ He2) as Hi2.
        rewrite Heq in Hi2. lia.
  Qed.

  Lemma cells۰pendingｰinstall 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' :
    is_pow2 (length cs) →
    is_pow2 (length cs') →
    cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs →
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' →
    (∀ j c', cs' !! j = Some c' → c' ≠ CellInit) →
      (∀ i c, cs !! i = Some c → cell۰is_frozen c) ∧
      (∀ j c', cs' !! j = Some c' → cell۰is_active c') ∧
      (∀ 𝑘𝑒𝑦, cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs' 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs 𝑘𝑒𝑦).
  Proof.
    intros Hcap Hcap' Hcs Hpending Hinit.
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hcap).
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hcap').
    destruct Hpending as [(Hlen & Hpending) | (Hlen & Hpending)]; split_and!.
    - intros i c Hlookup.
      pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hlookup).
      destruct (lookup_lt_is_Some_2 cs' i) as (c' & Hlookup'); first lia.
      opose proof* (Hpending i c' Hlookup') as [? | (es & Hes & _)]; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | ].
      rewrite Nat.mod_small // in Hes. simplify_eq. by eexists.
    - intros j c' Hlookup.
      opose proof* (Hpending j c' Hlookup) as [? | (es & _ & ?)]; try subst c'; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | by eexists].
    - intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
      rewrite /cells۰lookup Hlen.
      pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (2 * length cs) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ltac:(lia)) as Hlt.
      destruct (lookup_lt_is_Some_2 cs' (entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (2 * length cs) 𝑘𝑒𝑦)) as (c' & Hlookup'); first lia.
      opose proof* (Hpending _ c' Hlookup') as [? | (es & Hes & ?)]; try subst c'; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | ].
      rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hlookup').
      rewrite entries۰indexｰhalf // in Hes.
      rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hes) /=.
      apply entries۰lookupｰfilter.
      intros e He <-.
      rewrite entries۰indexｰdouble //.
      pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) e.2 ltac:(lia)).
      pose proof (entries۰indexｰland 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) e.2 Hcap) as [Hland | Hland];
        rewrite Hland; repeat case_bool_decide; lia.
    - intros i c Hlookup.
      pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hlookup).
      destruct (decide (i < length cs')).
      + destruct (lookup_lt_is_Some_2 cs' i) as (c' & Hlookup'); first lia.
        opose proof* (Hpending i c' Hlookup') as [? | (es1 & es2 & Hes1 & _ & _)]; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | ].
        simplify_eq. by eexists.
      + destruct (lookup_lt_is_Some_2 cs' (i - length cs')) as (c' & Hlookup'); first lia.
        opose proof* (Hpending _ c' Hlookup') as [? | (es1 & es2 & _ & Hes2 & _)]; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | ].
        rewrite Nat.sub_add in Hes2; first lia.
        simplify_eq. by eexists.
    - intros j c' Hlookup.
      opose proof* (Hpending j c' Hlookup) as [? | (es1 & es2 & _ & _ & ?)]; try subst c'; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | by eexists].
    - intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
      rewrite /cells۰lookup Hlen.
      pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs') 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ltac:(lia)) as Hlt.
      destruct (lookup_lt_is_Some_2 cs' (entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs') 𝑘𝑒𝑦)) as (c' & Hlookup'); first lia.
      opose proof* (Hpending _ c' Hlookup') as [? | (es1 & es2 & Hes1 & Hes2 & ?)]; try subst c'; [by exfalso; eapply Hinit; [eassumption | done] | ].
      rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hlookup') /= entries۰lookupｰapp.
      opose proof* (Hcs _ _ Hes1) as Hwf1.
      opose proof* (Hcs _ _ Hes2) as Hwf2.
      rewrite Hlen in Hwf1 Hwf2.
      pose proof (entries۰indexｰdouble 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs') 𝑘𝑒𝑦 Hcap') as Hidx.
      rewrite Hidx.
      case_bool_decide.
      + rewrite (entries۰wfｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hwf1); first lia.
        rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hes2) /=.
        destruct (entries۰lookup _ _); done.
      + rewrite Nat.add_0_r.
        rewrite (entries۰wfｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hwf2); first lia.
        rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hes1) //.
  Qed.

  Lemma cells۰pendingｰinsert 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' j c' :
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs' →
    (length cs' = 2 * length cs → cells۰pending۰split 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs j c') →
    (length cs = 2 * length cs' → cells۰pending۰merge cs (length cs') j c') →
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs (<[j := c']> cs').
  Proof.
    intros [(Hlen & Hpending) | (Hlen & Hpending)] Hsplit Hmerge.
    - left. rewrite length_insert. split; first done.
      intros j' c'' [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hj')]%list_lookup_insert_Some.
      + apply Hsplit. done.
      + apply Hpending. done.
    - right. rewrite length_insert. split; first done.
      intros j' c'' [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hj')]%list_lookup_insert_Some.
      + apply Hmerge. done.
      + apply Hpending. done.
  Qed.
End entries.

#[global] Arguments cell : clear implicits.
#[global] Arguments CellInit {_}.

Lemma Z_lor_1_odd (k : Z) :
  Z.Odd (Z.lor k 1).
Proof.
  apply Z.odd_spec. rewrite -Z.bit0_odd Z.lor_spec orb_true_r //.
Qed.

Section htbl۰valid.
  Context `{zoo۰G : !ZooG Σ}.

  Context {Key : Type} `{!EqDecision Key}.
  Context (key۰model : val → Key → iProp Σ).

  Implicit Type 𝑘𝑒𝑦 : Key.
  Implicit Type 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 : Key → Z.

  Definition htbl۰valid۰functional : iProp Σ :=
    □ ∀ key 𝑘𝑒𝑦1 𝑘𝑒𝑦2,
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦1 -∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦2 -∗
      ⌜𝑘𝑒𝑦1 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦2⌝.

  Definition htbl۰valid۰hash hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 : iProp Σ :=
    □ ∀ key 𝑘𝑒𝑦,
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 -∗
      WP hash key {{ res,
        ⌜res = #(𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦)⌝
      }}.

  Definition htbl۰valid۰equal equal : iProp Σ :=
    □ ∀ key1 𝑘𝑒𝑦1 key2 𝑘𝑒𝑦2,
      key۰model key1 𝑘𝑒𝑦1 -∗
      key۰model key2 𝑘𝑒𝑦2 -∗
      WP equal key1 key2 {{ res,
        ⌜res = #(bool_decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦1 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦2))⌝
      }}.

  Definition htbl۰valid hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 equal : iProp Σ :=
    htbl۰valid۰functional ∗
    htbl۰valid۰hash hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 ∗
    htbl۰valid۰equal equal.
End htbl۰valid.

Axiom htbl٠bucket٠dissocｰspec : ∀ `{zoo۰G : !ZooG Σ} {Key} `{!EqDecision Key}
  (key۰model : val → Key → iProp Σ) equal key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 bucket 𝑘𝑒𝑦𝑠 Φ,
  length 𝑘𝑒𝑦𝑠 = length bucket →
  htbl۰valid۰equal key۰model equal -∗
  □ key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 -∗
  □ ([∗ list] key'; 𝑘𝑒𝑦' ∈ bucket.*1; 𝑘𝑒𝑦𝑠, key۰model key' 𝑘𝑒𝑦') -∗
  ▷ Φ (
    option۰to_val (
      (λ '(i, _), bucket۰to_val (delete i bucket)) <$>
      list_find (λ 𝑘𝑒𝑦', 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦') 𝑘𝑒𝑦𝑠
    )
  ) -∗
  WP htbl٠bucket٠dissoc equal key (bucket۰to_val bucket) {{ Φ }}.


Axiom htbl٠min_bucketsｰspec :
  htbl٠min_buckets = #16.
Axiom htbl٠max_bucketsｰspec :
  ∃ n : Z, htbl٠max_buckets = #n.


Definition status۰to_val (o : option (location * nat)) :=
  match o with
  | None =>
      §htbl٠Normal%V
  | Some (buckets, cap) =>
      ‘htbl٠Resizing( #buckets, #(⁺cap - 1) )%V
  end.

Definition state۰to_val (buckets : location) (cap : nat) o :=
  (#buckets, #(⁺cap - 1), status۰to_val o)%V.

Lemma status۰to_valｰsimilarｰNormal o :
  status۰to_val o ≈ §htbl٠Normal%V →
  o = None.
Proof.
  destruct o as [[] |]; done.
Qed.

Lemma state۰to_valｰsimilar buckets1 cap1 o1 buckets2 cap2 o2 :
  state۰to_val buckets1 cap1 o1 ≈ state۰to_val buckets2 cap2 o2 →
    buckets1 = buckets2 ∧
    cap1 = cap2 ∧
    o1 = o2.
Proof.
  intros H.
  destruct o1 as [[] |], o2 as [[] |]; cbn in H; try done.
  all: destruct_and! H; simplify_eq.
  all: split_and!; try done; try lia.
  all: repeat f_equal; lia.
Qed.


Zoo name :=
  { self : location
  ; inv : namespace
  ; model : gname
  ; gens : gname
  ; current : gname
  ; frozen : gname
  ; inited : gname
  ; waiters : gname
  }.

Zoo global :=
  { model : twins (leibnizO (gmap positive val))
  ; gens : mono_list (location * nat)
  ; current : auth_nat_max
  ; frozen : ghost_map (nat * nat) (list (val * val * positive)) : iris
  ; inited : mono_gset (nat * nat)
  ; waiters : ghost_map gname (nat * val) : iris
  ; waiter۰post : saved_pred (option val)
  }.

Section htbl۰G.
  Context `{htbl۰G : HtblG Σ}.

  Context {Key : Type} `{Countable Key}.
  Context (key۰model : val → Key → iProp Σ).
  Context `{key۰modelｰpersistent : !∀ key 𝑘𝑒𝑦, Persistent (key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦)}.

  Implicit Type 𝑘𝑒𝑦 : Key.
  Implicit Type 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 : Key → Z.
  Implicit Type m : gmap Key val.
  Implicit Type e : val * val * Key.
  Implicit Type es : list (val * val * Key).
  Implicit Type c : cell Key.
  Implicit Type cs : list (cell Key).
  Implicit Type gen : location * list (cell Key).
  Implicit Type gens : list (location * list (cell Key)).
  Implicit Type η : gname.
  Implicit Type w : nat * val.
  Implicit Type ws : gmap gname (nat * val).
  Implicit Type cur g i j : nat.

  Definition entries۰model es : iProp Σ :=
    [∗ list] e ∈ es, key۰model e.1.1 e.2.

  #[global] Instance entries۰modelｰpersistent es :
    Persistent (entries۰model es).
  Proof.
    apply _.
  Qed.

  #[local] Definition model₁' (γ_model : gname) m :=
    twins۰twin₁ γ_model (DfracOwn 1) (kmap encode m : gmap positive val).
  #[local] Definition model₁ γ :=
    model₁' γ.(htbl۰name۰model).
  #[local] Definition model₂' (γ_model : gname) m :=
    twins۰twin₂ γ_model (kmap encode m : gmap positive val).
  #[local] Definition model₂ γ :=
    model₂' γ.(htbl۰name۰model).

  #[local] Definition gens۰phys gens :=
    (λ gen, (gen.1, length gen.2)) <$> gens.
  #[local] Definition gens۰auth' (γ_gens : gname) gens :=
    mono_list۰auth γ_gens (DfracOwn 1) (gens۰phys gens).
  #[local] Definition gens۰auth γ :=
    gens۰auth' γ.(htbl۰name۰gens).
  #[local] Definition gens۰at γ g (buckets : location) (cap : nat) :=
    mono_list۰at γ.(htbl۰name۰gens) g (buckets, cap).

  #[local] Definition current۰auth' (γ_current : gname) :=
    auth_nat_max۰auth γ_current (DfracOwn 1).
  #[local] Definition current۰auth γ :=
    current۰auth' γ.(htbl۰name۰current).
  #[local] Definition current۰lb γ :=
    auth_nat_max۰lb γ.(htbl۰name۰current).

  #[local] Definition frozen۰auth' (γ_frozen : gname) (F : gmap (nat * nat) (list (val * val * positive))) :=
    ghost_map_auth γ_frozen (DfracOwn 1) F.
  #[local] Definition frozen۰auth γ :=
    frozen۰auth' γ.(htbl۰name۰frozen).
  #[local] Definition frozen۰elem' γ (g i : nat) (bucket : list (val * val * positive)) :=
    ghost_map_elem γ.(htbl۰name۰frozen) (g, i) DfracDiscarded bucket.
  #[local] Definition frozen۰elem γ g i es :=
    frozen۰elem' γ g i (entries۰encode es).

  #[local] Definition inited۰auth' (γ_inited : gname) :=
    mono_gset۰auth γ_inited (DfracOwn 1).
  #[local] Definition inited۰auth γ :=
    inited۰auth' γ.(htbl۰name۰inited).
  #[local] Definition inited۰elem γ (g j : nat) :=
    mono_gset۰elem γ.(htbl۰name۰inited) (g, j).

  #[local] Definition waiters۰auth' (γ_waiters : gname) ws :=
    ghost_map_auth γ_waiters (DfracOwn 1) ws.
  #[local] Definition waiters۰auth γ :=
    waiters۰auth' γ.(htbl۰name۰waiters).
  #[local] Definition waiters۰elem γ η w :=
    ghost_map_elem γ.(htbl۰name۰waiters) η (DfracOwn 1) w.

  #[local] Definition gens۰state gens cur (resizing : bool) :=
    let gen := gens !!! cur in
    let gen' := gens !!! S cur in
    state۰to_val gen.1 (length gen.2) (if resizing then Some (gen'.1, length gen'.2) else None).

  Record inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur (resizing : bool) m (F : gmap (nat * nat) (list (val * val * positive))) (I : gset (nat * nat)) ws : Prop :=
    { inv۰pure۰length :
        length gens = S cur + Nat.b2n resizing
    ; inv۰pure۰nodup :
        NoDup gens.*1
    ; inv۰pure۰pow2 g gen :
        gens !! g = Some gen →
        is_pow2 (length gen.2)
    ; inv۰pure۰caps g gen gen' :
        gens !! g = Some gen →
        gens !! S g = Some gen' →
          length gen'.2 = 2 * length gen.2 ∨
          length gen.2 = 2 * length gen'.2
    ; inv۰pure۰wf g gen :
        gens !! g = Some gen →
        cells۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gen.2
    ; inv۰pure۰old g gen i c :
        g < cur →
        gens !! g = Some gen →
        gen.2 !! i = Some c →
        cell۰is_frozen c
    ; inv۰pure۰cur gen i c :
        gens !! cur = Some gen →
        gen.2 !! i = Some c →
        if resizing then c ≠ CellInit else cell۰is_active c
    ; inv۰pure۰pending gen gen' :
        resizing →
        gens !! cur = Some gen →
        gens !! S cur = Some gen' →
        cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gen.2 gen'.2
    ; inv۰pure۰model gen :
        gens !! cur = Some gen →
        ∀ 𝑘𝑒𝑦, m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gen.2 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    ; inv۰pure۰frozen g i bucket :
        F !! (g, i) = Some bucket ↔
          ∃ gen es,
          gens !! g = Some gen ∧
          gen.2 !! i = Some (CellFrozen es) ∧
          entries۰encode es = bucket
    ; inv۰pure۰inited g j :
        (g, j) ∈ I →
          ∃ gen c,
          gens !! g = Some gen ∧
          gen.2 !! j = Some c ∧
          c ≠ CellInit
    ; inv۰pure۰waiters η w :
        ws !! η = Some w →
        w.1 ≤ cur
    }.

  #[local] Definition waiter۰au γ 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (Ψ : option val → iProp Σ) : iProp Σ :=
    AU <{
      ∃∃ m,
      model₁ γ m
    }> @ ⊤ ∖ ↑γ.(htbl۰name۰inv), ∅ <{
      model₁ γ m
    , COMM
      Ψ (m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦)
    }>.
  #[local] Definition waiter۰model γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur η w : iProp Σ :=
    ∃ 𝑘𝑒𝑦 Ψ,
    key۰model w.2 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∗
    saved_pred η Ψ ∗
    if decide (w.1 = cur) then
      waiter۰au γ 𝑘𝑒𝑦 Ψ
    else
      Ψ (cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (gens !!! w.1).2 𝑘𝑒𝑦).

  #[local] Definition inv۰inner γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 : iProp Σ :=
    ∃ gens cur resizing m F I ws,
    γ.(htbl۰name۰self).[state] ↦ gens۰state gens cur resizing ∗
    model₂ γ m ∗
    gens۰auth γ gens ∗
    current۰auth γ cur ∗
    frozen۰auth γ F ∗
    ( [∗ map] gi ↦ bucket ∈ F,
      frozen۰elem' γ gi.1 gi.2 bucket
    ) ∗
    inited۰auth γ I ∗
    waiters۰auth γ ws ∗
    ( [∗ list] gen ∈ gens,
      array۰model #gen.1 (DfracOwn 1) (cell۰to_val <$> gen.2)
    ) ∗
    ( [∗ list] gen ∈ gens,
      [∗ list] c ∈ gen.2,
      entries۰model (cell۰entries c)
    ) ∗
    ⌜inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws⌝ ∗
    ( [∗ map] η ↦ w ∈ ws,
      waiter۰model γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur η w
    ).
  #[local] Instance : CustomIpat "inv۰inner" :=
    " ( %gens{} & %cur{} & %resizing{} & %m{} & %F{} & %I{} & %ws{} & >Hself_state & >Hmodel₂ & >Hgens_auth & >Hcurrent_auth & >Hfrozen_auth & >#Hfrozen_elems & >Hinited_auth & >Hwaiters_auth & >Harrays & #Hentries & >%Hinv{} & Hwaiters ) ".
  #[local] Definition inv' γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 :=
    inv γ.(htbl۰name۰inv) (inv۰inner γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩).
  Please Definition htbl۰inv γ ι : iProp Σ :=
    ∃ hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 equal sizes (sz : nat),
    ⌜ι = γ.(htbl۰name۰inv)⌝ ∗
    γ.(htbl۰name۰self).[hash] ↦□ hash ∗
    γ.(htbl۰name۰self).[equal] ↦□ equal ∗
    γ.(htbl۰name۰self).[sizes] ↦□ sizes ∗
    ⌜0 < sz⌝ ∗
    itype۰array itype۰int sz sizes ∗
    htbl۰valid key۰model hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 equal ∗
    inv' γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩.
  #[local] Instance : CustomIpat "inv" :=
    " ( %hash & %𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 & %equal & %sizes & %sz & -> & #Hself_hash & #Hself_equal & #Hself_sizes & %Hsz & #Hsizes & #(#Hvalid_functional & #Hvalid_hash & #Hvalid_equal) & #Hinv ) ".

  Please Definition htbl۰model γ m : iProp Σ :=
    model₁ γ m.
  #[local] Instance : CustomIpat "model" :=
    " Hmodel₁{_{}} ".

  Zoo derive Timeless for htbl۰model.

  Zoo derive Persistent for htbl۰inv.

  #[local] Lemma kmap_encodeｰinj m1 m2 :
    kmap (M2 := gmap positive) encode m1 = kmap encode m2 →
    m1 = m2.
  Proof.
    intros Heq. apply map_eq. intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
    rewrite -(lookup_kmap encode m1 𝑘𝑒𝑦) -(lookup_kmap encode m2 𝑘𝑒𝑦) Heq //.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma modelｰalloc :
    ⊢ |==>
      ∃ γ_model,
      model₁' γ_model ∅ ∗
      model₂' γ_model ∅.
  Proof.
    apply twinsｰalloc'.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma model₁ｰexclusive γ m1 m2 :
    model₁ γ m1 -∗
    model₁ γ m2 -∗
    False.
  Proof.
    apply twins۰twin₁ｰexclusive.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma modelｰagree γ m1 m2 :
    model₁ γ m1 -∗
    model₂ γ m2 -∗
    ⌜m1 = m2⌝.
  Proof.
    iIntros "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂".
    iDestruct (twinsｰagreeｰL with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %?%kmap_encodeｰinj.
    iSteps.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma modelｰupdate {γ m1 m2} m :
    model₁ γ m1 -∗
    model₂ γ m2 ==∗
      model₁ γ m ∗
      model₂ γ m.
  Proof.
    apply twinsｰupdate.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma gensｰalloc gens :
    ⊢ |==>
      ∃ γ_gens,
      gens۰auth' γ_gens gens.
  Proof.
    apply mono_listｰalloc.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma gens۰atｰget {γ gens} g gen :
    gens !! g = Some gen →
    gens۰auth γ gens ⊢
    gens۰at γ g gen.1 (length gen.2).
  Proof.
    intros Hlookup.
    apply mono_list۰atｰget.
    rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hlookup //.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma gens۰atｰvalid γ gens g buckets cap :
    gens۰auth γ gens -∗
    gens۰at γ g buckets cap -∗
      ∃ cs,
      ⌜gens !! g = Some (buckets, cs)⌝ ∗
      ⌜length cs = cap⌝.
  Proof.
    iIntros "Hauth Hat".
    iDestruct (mono_list۰atｰvalid with "Hauth Hat") as %(gen & [= -> ->] & Hlookup)%list_lookup_fmap_Some.
    destruct gen as (buckets, cs).
    iSteps.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma gensｰupdate {γ gens} gen :
    gens۰auth γ gens ⊢ |==>
      gens۰auth γ (gens ++ [gen]) ∗
      gens۰at γ (length gens) gen.1 (length gen.2).
  Proof.
    iIntros "Hauth".
    iMod (mono_listｰupdateｰsnoc (gen.1, length gen.2) with "Hauth") as "Hauth".
    assert (gens۰phys gens ++ [(gen.1, length gen.2)] = gens۰phys (gens ++ [gen])) as ->.
    { rewrite /gens۰phys fmap_app //. }
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰget (length gens) gen with "Hauth") as "#Hat".
    { rewrite lookup_snoc_Some. naive. }
    iSteps.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma currentｰalloc :
    ⊢ |==>
      ∃ γ_current,
      current۰auth' γ_current 0.
  Proof.
    apply auth_nat_maxｰalloc.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma current۰lbｰget γ cur :
    current۰auth γ cur ⊢
    current۰lb γ cur.
  Proof.
    apply auth_nat_max۰lbｰget.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma current۰lbｰvalid γ cur g :
    current۰auth γ cur -∗
    current۰lb γ g -∗
    ⌜g ≤ cur⌝.
  Proof.
    apply auth_nat_max۰lbｰvalid.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma currentｰupdate {γ cur} cur' :
    cur ≤ cur' →
    current۰auth γ cur ⊢ |==>
    current۰auth γ cur'.
  Proof.
    apply auth_nat_maxｰupdate.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma frozenｰalloc :
    ⊢ |==>
      ∃ γ_frozen,
      frozen۰auth' γ_frozen ∅.
  Proof.
    apply ghost_map_alloc_empty.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma frozen۰elemｰvalid γ F g i es :
    frozen۰auth γ F -∗
    frozen۰elem γ g i es -∗
    ⌜F !! (g, i) = Some (entries۰encode es)⌝.
  Proof.
    apply ghost_map_lookup.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma frozenｰinsert {γ F} g i es :
    F !! (g, i) = None →
    frozen۰auth γ F ⊢ |==>
      frozen۰auth γ (<[(g, i) := entries۰encode es]> F) ∗
      frozen۰elem γ g i es.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hlookup Hauth".
    iMod (ghost_map_insert with "Hauth") as "($ & Helem)"; first done.
    iApply (ghost_map_elem_persist with "Helem").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma initedｰalloc :
    ⊢ |==>
      ∃ γ_inited,
      inited۰auth' γ_inited ∅.
  Proof.
    apply mono_gsetｰalloc.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma inited۰elemｰvalid γ I g j :
    inited۰auth γ I -∗
    inited۰elem γ g j -∗
    ⌜(g, j) ∈ I⌝.
  Proof.
    apply mono_gset۰elemｰvalid.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma initedｰinsert {γ I} g j :
    inited۰auth γ I ⊢ |==>
      inited۰auth γ ({[(g, j)]} ∪ I) ∗
      inited۰elem γ g j.
  Proof.
    apply mono_gsetｰinsert'.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma waitersｰalloc :
    ⊢ |==>
      ∃ γ_waiters,
      waiters۰auth' γ_waiters ∅.
  Proof.
    apply ghost_map_alloc_empty.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma waiters۰elemｰvalid γ ws η w :
    waiters۰auth γ ws -∗
    waiters۰elem γ η w -∗
    ⌜ws !! η = Some w⌝.
  Proof.
    apply ghost_map_lookup.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma waitersｰinsert {γ ws} η w :
    ws !! η = None →
    waiters۰auth γ ws ⊢ |==>
      waiters۰auth γ (<[η := w]> ws) ∗
      waiters۰elem γ η w.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hlookup Hauth".
    iApply (ghost_map_insert with "Hauth"). done.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma waitersｰdelete γ ws η w :
    waiters۰auth γ ws -∗
    waiters۰elem γ η w ==∗
    waiters۰auth γ (delete η ws).
  Proof.
    apply ghost_map_delete.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma cells۰pendingｰmono 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs1 cs2 cs' :
    length cs1 = length cs2 →
    (∀ k es, cs1 !! k = Some (CellFrozen es) → cs2 !! k = Some (CellFrozen es)) →
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs1 cs' →
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs2 cs'.
  Proof.
    intros Hlen Hfrozen [(Hlen' & Hpending) | (Hlen' & Hpending)].
    - left. split; first lia.
      intros j c' Hlookup.
      destruct (Hpending j c' Hlookup) as [-> | (es & Hes & ->)]; first by left.
      right. exists es. rewrite -Hlen. split; last done.
      apply Hfrozen. done.
    - right. split; first lia.
      intros j c' Hlookup.
      destruct (Hpending j c' Hlookup) as [-> | (es1 & es2 & Hes1 & Hes2 & ->)]; first by left.
      right. exists es1, es2. split_and!; [apply Hfrozen.. | ]; done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰlookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    ∃ gen,
    gens !! cur = Some gen.
  Proof.
    intros Hinv.
    apply lookup_lt_is_Some_2. rewrite (inv۰pure۰length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv). lia.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰfreeze 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur m F I ws buckets cs i es :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur true m F I ws →
    gens !! cur = Some (buckets, cs) →
    cs !! i = Some (CellActive es) →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩
      (<[cur := (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es]> cs)]> gens)
      cur true m
      (<[(cur, i) := entries۰encode es]> F)
      I ws.
  Proof.
    intros [Hlength Hnodup Hpow2 Hcaps Hwf Hold Hcur Hpending Hmodel Hfrozen Hinited Hwaiters] Hlookup Hi.
    pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hi).
    pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hlookup).
    pose proof (Hgen := λ g gen, list_lookup_insert_Some gens cur (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es]> cs) g gen).
    split.
    - rewrite length_insert //.
    - rewrite list_fmap_insert /= list_insert_id //.
      rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hlookup //.
    - intros g gen [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen.
      + rewrite /= length_insert.
        apply (Hpow2 cur _ Hlookup).
      + apply (Hpow2 g _ Hlookup').
    - intros g gen gen' Hg Hg'.
      assert (∀ g gen, <[cur := (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es]> cs)]> gens !! g = Some gen → ∃ gen0, gens !! g = Some gen0 ∧ length gen.2 = length gen0.2) as Hlen.
      { intros g0 gen0 [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen.
        - exists (buckets, cs). rewrite /= length_insert //.
        - exists gen0. done.
      }
      destruct (Hlen _ _ Hg) as (gen0 & Hg0 & ->).
      destruct (Hlen _ _ Hg') as (gen0' & Hg0' & ->).
      apply (Hcaps g); done.
    - intros g gen [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen.
      + apply cells۰wfｰinsert.
        * rewrite /=. apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup _ _ Hi).
        * apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup).
      + apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup').
    - intros g gen i' c Hg [(-> & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (Hold g gen i' c Hg Hlookup').
    - intros gen i' c [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some.
      intros [(_ & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]; first done.
      apply (Hcur _ _ _ Hlookup Hlookup').
    - intros gen gen' Hresizing [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      intros [(? & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (cells۰pendingｰmono _ cs); [rewrite length_insert // | | apply (Hpending _ _ Hresizing Hlookup Hlookup')].
      intros k es' Hk.
      rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //. congruence.
    - intros gen [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
      rewrite (Hmodel _ Hlookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦) /= cells۰lookupｰinsert //.
      case_decide as Hidx; last done.
      rewrite /cells۰lookup Hidx (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hi) //.
    - intros g i' bucket.
      rewrite lookup_insert_Some Hfrozen.
      split.
      + intros [([= <- <-] & <-) | (Hne & gen & es' & Hg & Hi' & <-)].
        * exists (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es]> cs), es.
          rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq // /= list_lookup_insert_eq //.
        * destruct (decide (g = cur)) as [-> |].
          -- rewrite Hlookup in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
             exists (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es]> cs), es'.
             rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq // /= list_lookup_insert_ne //.
             intros ->. congruence.
          -- exists gen, es'. rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //.
      + intros (gen & es' & [(<- & <- & _) | (Hne & Hg)]%Hgen & Hi' & <-).
        * rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some in Hi'.
          destruct Hi' as [(<- & [= <-] & _) | (Hne & Hi')]; first by left.
          right. split; first congruence.
          exists (buckets, cs), es'. done.
        * right. split; first congruence.
          exists gen, es'. done.
    - intros g j HI.
      destruct (Hinited g j HI) as (gen & c & Hg & Hj & Hc).
      destruct (decide (g = cur)) as [-> |].
      + rewrite Hlookup in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
        exists (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es]> cs), (if decide (j = i) then CellFrozen es else c).
        rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq //.
        split; first done.
        rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some.
        case_decide as Hji.
        * subst. split; last done.
          left. split_and!; [done | done | eapply lookup_lt_Some; done].
        * split; last done.
          right. done.
      + exists gen, c. rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //.
    - done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰupdate 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws buckets cs i es es' m' :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    gens !! cur = Some (buckets, cs) →
    cs !! i = Some (CellActive es) →
    entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) i es' →
    ( ∀ 𝑘𝑒𝑦,
      m' !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦 =
        if decide (entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (length cs) 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = i) then
          entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es'
        else
          m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    ) →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩
      (<[cur := (buckets, <[i := CellActive es']> cs)]> gens)
      cur resizing m' F I ws.
  Proof.
    intros [Hlength Hnodup Hpow2 Hcaps Hwf Hold Hcur Hpending Hmodel Hfrozen Hinited Hwaiters] Hlookup Hi Hes' Hm'.
    pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hi).
    pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hlookup).
    pose proof (Hgen := λ g gen, list_lookup_insert_Some gens cur (buckets, <[i := CellActive es']> cs) g gen).
    split.
    - rewrite length_insert //.
    - rewrite list_fmap_insert /= list_insert_id //.
      rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hlookup //.
    - intros g gen [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen.
      + rewrite /= length_insert.
        apply (Hpow2 cur _ Hlookup).
      + apply (Hpow2 g _ Hlookup').
    - intros g gen gen' Hg Hg'.
      assert (∀ g gen, <[cur := (buckets, <[i := CellActive es']> cs)]> gens !! g = Some gen → ∃ gen0, gens !! g = Some gen0 ∧ length gen.2 = length gen0.2) as Hlen.
      { intros g0 gen0 [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen.
        - exists (buckets, cs). rewrite /= length_insert //.
        - exists gen0. done.
      }
      destruct (Hlen _ _ Hg) as (gen0 & Hg0 & ->).
      destruct (Hlen _ _ Hg') as (gen0' & Hg0' & ->).
      apply (Hcaps g); done.
    - intros g gen [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen.
      + apply cells۰wfｰinsert; first done.
        apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup).
      + apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup').
    - intros g gen i' c Hg [(-> & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (Hold g gen i' c Hg Hlookup').
    - intros gen i' c [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some.
      intros [(_ & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup')].
      + destruct resizing; [done | by eexists].
      + apply (Hcur _ _ _ Hlookup Hlookup').
    - intros gen gen' Hresizing [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      intros [(? & _) | (_ & Hlookup')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (cells۰pendingｰmono _ cs); [rewrite length_insert // | | apply (Hpending _ _ Hresizing Hlookup Hlookup')].
      intros k es'' Hk.
      rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //. congruence.
    - intros gen [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
      rewrite Hm' /= cells۰lookupｰinsert //.
      case_decide; first done.
      apply (Hmodel _ Hlookup).
    - intros g i' bucket.
      rewrite Hfrozen.
      split.
      + intros (gen & es'' & Hg & Hi' & <-).
        destruct (decide (g = cur)) as [-> |].
        * rewrite Hlookup in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
          exists (buckets, <[i := CellActive es']> cs), es''.
          rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq // /= list_lookup_insert_ne //.
          intros ->. simpl in Hi'. congruence.
        * exists gen, es''. rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //.
      + intros (gen & es'' & [(<- & <- & _) | (Hne & Hg)]%Hgen & Hi' & <-).
        * rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some in Hi'.
          destruct Hi' as [(<- & [=] & _) | (Hne & Hi')].
          exists (buckets, cs), es''. done.
        * exists gen, es''. done.
    - intros g j HI.
      destruct (Hinited g j HI) as (gen & c & Hg & Hj & Hc).
      destruct (decide (g = cur)) as [-> |].
      + rewrite Hlookup in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
        exists (buckets, <[i := CellActive es']> cs), (if decide (j = i) then CellActive es' else c).
        rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq //.
        split; first done.
        rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some.
        case_decide as Hji.
        * subst. split; last done.
          left. split_and!; [done | done | eapply lookup_lt_Some; done].
        * split; last done.
          right. done.
      + exists gen, c. rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //.
    - done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰinit 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur m F I ws buckets cs buckets' cs' j es' :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur true m F I ws →
    gens !! cur = Some (buckets, cs) →
    gens !! S cur = Some (buckets', cs') →
    cs' !! j = Some CellInit →
    cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs (<[j := CellActive es']> cs') →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩
      (<[S cur := (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs')]> gens)
      cur true m F
      ({[(S cur, j)]} ∪ I)
      ws.
  Proof.
    intros [Hlength Hnodup Hpow2 Hcaps Hwf Hold Hcur Hpending Hmodel Hfrozen Hinited Hwaiters] Hlookup Hlookup' Hj Hpending'.
    pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hj).
    pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hlookup').
    pose proof (Hgen := λ g gen, list_lookup_insert_Some gens (S cur) (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs') g gen).
    assert (∀ g gen, <[S cur := (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs')]> gens !! g = Some gen → ∃ gen0, gens !! g = Some gen0 ∧ length gen.2 = length gen0.2) as Hlen.
    { intros g0 gen0 [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup'')]%Hgen.
      - exists (buckets', cs'). rewrite /= length_insert //.
      - exists gen0. done.
    }
    split.
    - rewrite length_insert //.
    - rewrite list_fmap_insert /= list_insert_id //.
      rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hlookup' //.
    - intros g gen (gen0 & Hg0 & ->)%Hlen. apply (Hpow2 _ _ Hg0).
    - intros g gen gen' (gen0 & Hg0 & ->)%Hlen (gen0' & Hg0' & ->)%Hlen.
      apply (Hcaps g); done.
    - intros g gen [(<- & <- & _) | (_ & Hlookup'')]%Hgen.
      + apply (cells۰pendingｰwf _ cs); last done.
        * apply (Hpow2 _ _ Hlookup).
        * rewrite length_insert. apply (Hpow2 _ _ Hlookup').
        * apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup).
      + apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup'').
    - intros g gen i' c Hg [(? & _) | (_ & Hlookup'')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (Hold g gen i' c Hg Hlookup'').
    - intros gen i' c [(? & _) | (_ & Hlookup'')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (Hcur _ _ _ Hlookup'').
    - intros gen gen' _ [(? & _) | (_ & Hlookup'')]%Hgen; first lia.
      rewrite Hlookup in Hlookup''. injection Hlookup'' as <-.
      intros [(_ & <- & _) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last done.
      done.
    - intros gen [(? & _) | (_ & Hlookup'')]%Hgen; first lia.
      apply (Hmodel _ Hlookup'').
    - intros g i' bucket.
      rewrite Hfrozen.
      split.
      + intros (gen & es'' & Hg & Hi' & <-).
        destruct (decide (g = S cur)) as [-> |].
        * rewrite Hlookup' in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
          exists (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs'), es''.
          rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq // /= list_lookup_insert_ne //.
          intros ->. simpl in Hi'. congruence.
        * exists gen, es''. rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //.
      + intros (gen & es'' & [(<- & <- & _) | (Hne & Hg)]%Hgen & Hi' & <-).
        * rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some in Hi'.
          destruct Hi' as [(<- & [=] & _) | (Hne & Hi')].
          exists (buckets', cs'), es''. done.
        * exists gen, es''. done.
    - intros g j' [[= -> ->]%elem_of_singleton | HI]%elem_of_union.
      + exists (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs'), (CellActive es').
        rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq // /= list_lookup_insert_eq //.
      + destruct (Hinited g j' HI) as (gen & c & Hg & Hj' & Hc).
        destruct (decide (g = S cur)) as [-> |].
        * rewrite Hlookup' in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
          exists (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs'), (if decide (j' = j) then CellActive es' else c).
          rewrite list_lookup_insert_eq //.
          split; first done.
          rewrite /= list_lookup_insert_Some.
          case_decide as Hji.
          -- subst. split; last done.
             left. split_and!; [done | done | eapply lookup_lt_Some; done].
          -- split; last done.
             right. done.
        * exists gen, c. rewrite list_lookup_insert_ne //.
    - done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰinited 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws g j gen c :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    gens !! g = Some gen →
    gen.2 !! j = Some c →
    c ≠ CellInit →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F ({[(g, j)]} ∪ I) ws.
  Proof.
    intros [Hlength Hnodup Hpow2 Hcaps Hwf Hold Hcur Hpending Hmodel Hfrozen Hinited Hwaiters] Hg Hj Hc.
    split; try done.
    intros g' j' [[= -> ->]%elem_of_singleton | HI]%elem_of_union.
    - exists gen, c. done.
    - apply Hinited. done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰresize 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur m F I ws buckets cs buckets' cap' :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur false m F I ws →
    gens !! cur = Some (buckets, cs) →
    buckets' ∉ gens.*1 →
    is_pow2 cap' →
    cap' = 2 * length cs ∨ length cs = 2 * cap' →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 (gens ++ [(buckets', replicate cap' CellInit)]) cur true m F I ws.
  Proof.
    intros [Hlength Hnodup Hpow2 Hcaps Hwf Hold Hcur Hpending Hmodel Hfrozen Hinited Hwaiters] Hlookup Hbuckets' Hcap' Hrel.
    simpl in Hlength.
    pose proof (Hgen := λ g gen, lookup_snoc_Some (buckets', replicate cap' CellInit) gens g gen).
    split.
    - rewrite length_app /=. lia.
    - rewrite fmap_app NoDup_app. split_and!; [done | | apply NoDup_singleton].
      intros b Hb ->%list_elem_of_singleton. done.
    - intros g gen [(_ & Hg) | (_ & <-)]%Hgen.
      + apply (Hpow2 _ _ Hg).
      + rewrite /= length_replicate //.
    - intros g gen gen' [(_ & Hg) | (? & <-)]%Hgen [(_ & Hg') | (Heq & <-)]%Hgen.
      + apply (Hcaps g); done.
      + assert (g = cur) as -> by lia.
        rewrite Hlookup in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
        rewrite /= length_replicate. lia.
      + apply lookup_lt_Some in Hg'. lia.
      + lia.
    - intros g gen [(_ & Hg) | (_ & <-)]%Hgen.
      + apply (Hwf _ _ Hg).
      + intros i c (-> & _)%lookup_replicate.
        split; [apply Forall_nil | apply NoDup_nil]; done.
    - intros g gen i c Hg [(_ & Hg') | (? & _)]%Hgen; last lia.
      apply (Hold g gen i c Hg Hg').
    - intros gen i c [(_ & Hg) | (? & _)]%Hgen Hi; last lia.
      destruct (Hcur _ _ _ Hg Hi) as (es & ->). done.
    - intros gen gen' _ [(_ & Hg) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last lia.
      rewrite Hlookup in Hg. injection Hg as <-.
      intros [(? & _) | (_ & <-)]%Hgen; first lia.
      rewrite /cells۰pending /= length_replicate.
      destruct Hrel as [Hrel | Hrel]; [left | right]; (split; first lia);
        intros j c' (-> & _)%lookup_replicate; left; done.
    - intros gen [(_ & Hg) | (? & _)]%Hgen; last lia.
      apply (Hmodel _ Hg).
    - intros g i bucket.
      rewrite Hfrozen.
      split.
      + intros (gen & es & Hg & Hi & <-).
        exists gen, es. split_and!; try done.
        apply lookup_app_l_Some. done.
      + intros (gen & es & [(_ & Hg) | (_ & <-)]%Hgen & Hi & <-).
        * exists gen, es. done.
        * apply lookup_replicate in Hi as (? & _). done.
    - intros g j HI.
      destruct (Hinited g j HI) as (gen & c & Hg & Hj & Hc).
      exists gen, c. split_and!; try done.
      apply lookup_app_l_Some. done.
    - done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰinstall 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur m F I ws buckets cs buckets' cs' :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur true m F I ws →
    gens !! cur = Some (buckets, cs) →
    gens !! S cur = Some (buckets', cs') →
    (∀ j c', cs' !! j = Some c' → c' ≠ CellInit) →
      inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens (S cur) false m F I ws ∧
      ∀ 𝑘𝑒𝑦, cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs' 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = cells۰lookup 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
  Proof.
    intros Hinv Hlookup Hlookup' Hinit.
    destruct Hinv as [Hlength Hnodup Hpow2 Hcaps Hwf Hold Hcur Hpending Hmodel Hfrozen Hinited Hwaiters].
    opose proof* (cells۰pendingｰinstall 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs cs') as (Hfrozen' & Hactive' & Hlookups).
    { apply (Hpow2 _ _ Hlookup). }
    { apply (Hpow2 _ _ Hlookup'). }
    { apply (Hwf _ _ Hlookup). }
    { apply (Hpending _ _ ltac:(done) Hlookup Hlookup'). }
    { done. }
    split; last done.
    split; try done.
    - rewrite Hlength /=. lia.
    - intros g gen i c Hg Hgen Hi.
      destruct (decide (g = cur)) as [-> |].
      + rewrite Hlookup in Hgen. injection Hgen as <-.
        apply (Hfrozen' _ _ Hi).
      + apply (Hold g gen i c); [lia | done..].
    - intros gen i c Hgen Hi.
      rewrite Hlookup' in Hgen. injection Hgen as <-.
      apply (Hactive' _ _ Hi).
    - intros gen Hgen 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
      rewrite Hlookup' in Hgen. injection Hgen as <-.
      rewrite Hlookups. apply (Hmodel _ Hlookup).
    - intros η w Hw.
      opose proof* Hwaiters; first done. lia.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰwaitersｰinsert 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws η w :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    w.1 ≤ cur →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I (<[η := w]> ws).
  Proof.
    intros [] Hw. split; try done.
    intros η' w' [(<- & <-) | (_ & Hw')]%lookup_insert_Some; first done.
    naive.
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰwaitersｰdelete 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws η :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I (delete η ws).
  Proof.
    intros []. split; try done.
    intros η' w' (_ & Hw')%lookup_delete_Some. naive.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰcreate 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 buckets :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 [(buckets, replicate 16 (CellActive []))] 0 false ∅ ∅ ∅ ∅.
  Proof.
    split.
    - done.
    - apply NoDup_singleton.
    - intros g gen (-> & <-)%list_lookup_singleton_Some.
      exists 4. reflexivity.
    - intros g gen gen' _ (? & _)%list_lookup_singleton_Some. lia.
    - intros g gen (-> & <-)%list_lookup_singleton_Some i c (-> & _)%lookup_replicate.
      split; [apply Forall_nil | apply NoDup_nil]; done.
    - intros. lia.
    - intros gen i c (_ & <-)%list_lookup_singleton_Some (-> & _)%lookup_replicate.
      by eexists.
    - done.
    - intros gen (_ & <-)%list_lookup_singleton_Some 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
      rewrite lookup_empty /cells۰lookup list_lookup_total_alt.
      cbn [snd].
      rewrite lookup_replicate_2; last done.
      rewrite length_replicate. apply entries۰indexｰlt. lia.
    - intros g i bucket. rewrite lookup_empty. split; first done.
      intros (gen & es & (_ & <-)%list_lookup_singleton_Some & (? & _)%lookup_replicate & _).
      done.
    - set_solver.
    - done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Definition gen۰witness γ g buckets cap : iProp Σ :=
    gens۰at γ g buckets cap ∗
    array۰inv #buckets cap ∗
    ⌜is_pow2 cap⌝.
  #[local] Instance : CustomIpat "gen۰witness" :=
    " ( #Hgens_at{_{}} & #Harray_inv{_{}} & %Hpow2{_{}} ) ".

  #[local] Definition state۰witness γ s g buckets cap o : iProp Σ :=
    ⌜s = state۰to_val buckets cap o⌝ ∗
    current۰lb γ g ∗
    gen۰witness γ g buckets cap ∗
    match o with
    | None =>
        True
    | Some (buckets', cap') =>
        gen۰witness γ (S g) buckets' cap' ∗
        ⌜(cap' = 2 * cap ∨ cap = 2 * cap')%nat⌝
    end.
  #[local] Instance : CustomIpat "state۰witness" :=
    " ( -> & #Hcurrent_lb & (:gen۰witness) & Ho ) ".


  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰle 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws g gen :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    gens !! S g = Some gen →
    g ≤ cur.
  Proof.
    intros Hinv Hg%lookup_lt_Some.
    rewrite (inv۰pure۰length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv) in Hg.
    destruct resizing; simpl in Hg; lia.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma inv۰pureｰnot_init 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws g gen i c :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    gens !! g = Some gen →
    g ≤ cur →
    gen.2 !! i = Some c →
    c ≠ CellInit.
  Proof.
    intros Hinv Hg Hgcur Hi.
    destruct (decide (g = cur)) as [-> |].
    - opose proof* (inv۰pure۰cur _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv) as Hc; [done.. |].
      destruct resizing; first done.
      destruct Hc as (es & ->). done.
    - opose proof* (inv۰pure۰old _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv g) as (es & ->); [lia | done.. |].
      done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelｰlookup gens g gen i c :
    gens !! g = Some gen →
    gen.2 !! i = Some c →
    ( [∗ list] gen ∈ gens,
      [∗ list] c ∈ gen.2,
      entries۰model (cell۰entries c)
    ) ⊢
    entries۰model (cell۰entries c).
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hg %Hi Hentries".
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup with "Hentries") as "Hentries"; first done.
    iApply (big_sepL_lookup with "Hentries"). done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelｰagree es1 es2 :
    es1.*1 = es2.*1 →
    htbl۰valid۰functional key۰model -∗
    entries۰model es1 -∗
    entries۰model es2 -∗
    ⌜es1 = es2⌝.
  Proof.
    iInduction es1 as [| ((key1, v1), k1) es1] "IH" forall (es2).
    all: iIntros "%Heq #Hfunctional Hes1 Hes2".
    all: destruct es2 as [| ((key2, v2), k2) es2]; try done.
    simpl in Heq. injection Heq as -> -> Heq.
    rewrite /entries۰model !big_sepL_cons /=.
    iDestruct "Hes1" as "(Hkey1 & Hes1)".
    iDestruct "Hes2" as "(Hkey2 & Hes2)".
    iDestruct ("Hfunctional" with "Hkey1 Hkey2") as %->.
    iDestruct ("IH" with "[//] Hfunctional Hes1 Hes2") as %<-.
    iSteps.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma state۰witnessｰget γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    gens۰auth γ gens -∗
    current۰auth γ cur -∗
    ( [∗ list] gen ∈ gens,
      array۰model #gen.1 (DfracOwn 1) (cell۰to_val <$> gen.2)
    ) -∗
      gens۰auth γ gens ∗
      current۰auth γ cur ∗
      ( [∗ list] gen ∈ gens,
        array۰model #gen.1 (DfracOwn 1) (cell۰to_val <$> gen.2)
      ) ∗
      ∃ buckets cap o,
      state۰witness γ (gens۰state gens cur resizing) cur buckets cap o ∗
      ⌜if resizing then is_Some o else o = None⌝.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hinv Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays".
    destruct (inv۰pureｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv) as ((buckets, cs) & Hlookup).
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰget with "Hgens_auth") as "#Hgens_at"; first done.
    iDestruct (current۰lbｰget with "Hcurrent_auth") as "#Hcurrent_lb".
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first done.
    iDestruct (array۰modelｰtoｰinv with "Hmodel") as "#Harray_inv".
    iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
    rewrite length_fmap.
    pose proof (inv۰pure۰pow2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv _ _ Hlookup) as Hpow2.
    destruct resizing.
    - assert (is_Some (gens !! S cur)) as ((buckets', cs') & Hlookup').
      { apply lookup_lt_is_Some_2. rewrite (inv۰pure۰length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv) /=. lia. }
      iDestruct (gens۰atｰget with "Hgens_auth") as "#Hgens_at'"; first done.
      iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel' & Harrays)"; first done.
      iDestruct (array۰modelｰtoｰinv with "Hmodel'") as "#Harray_inv'".
      iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel'") as "Harrays".
      rewrite length_fmap.
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰pow2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv _ _ Hlookup') as Hpow2'.
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰caps _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv _ _ _ Hlookup Hlookup') as Hcaps.
      iFrame "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays".
      iExists buckets, (length cs), (Some (buckets', length cs')).
      rewrite /gens۰state (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hlookup) (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hlookup').
      iFrameSteps.
    - iFrame "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays".
      iExists buckets, (length cs), None.
      rewrite /gens۰state (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hlookup).
      iFrameSteps.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma state۰witnessｰsimilar γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws s g buckets cap o :
    inv۰pure 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur resizing m F I ws →
    gens۰state gens cur resizing ≈ s →
    gens۰auth γ gens -∗
    state۰witness γ s g buckets cap o -∗
    ⌜g = cur ∧ (if resizing then is_Some o else o = None)⌝.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hinv %Hs Hgens_auth (:state۰witness)".
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hlookup & _).
    destruct (inv۰pureｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv) as ((buckets0, cs0) & Hlookup0).
    rewrite /gens۰state (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hlookup0) /= in Hs.
    apply state۰to_valｰsimilar in Hs as (<- & _ & Ho).
    iPureIntro. split.
    - apply (NoDup_lookup gens.*1 g cur buckets0).
      + apply (inv۰pure۰nodup _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv).
      + rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hlookup //.
      + rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hlookup0 //.
    - destruct resizing; rewrite -Ho //.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰbucket c bucket :
    cell۰to_val c ≈ bucket۰to_val bucket →
      ∃ es,
      c = CellActive es ∧
      es.*1 = bucket.
  Proof.
    destruct c as [| es | es].
    - destruct bucket as [| (key, v) bucket]; cbn; done.
    - intros Heq%bucket۰to_valｰsimilar. eexists. done.
    - destruct bucket as [| (key, v) bucket]; cbn; done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰInit c :
    cell۰to_val c ≈ §htbl٠bucket٠Init%V →
    c = CellInit.
  Proof.
    destruct c as [| es | es]; first done.
    - destruct es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦) es]; cbn; done.
    - cbn. done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelsｰinsert gens g buckets cs i c c' :
    gens !! g = Some (buckets, cs) →
    cs !! i = Some c →
    ( [∗ list] gen ∈ gens,
      [∗ list] c ∈ gen.2,
      entries۰model (cell۰entries c)
    ) -∗
    entries۰model (cell۰entries c') -∗
    [∗ list] gen ∈ <[g := (buckets, <[i := c']> cs)]> gens,
      [∗ list] c ∈ gen.2,
      entries۰model (cell۰entries c).
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hg %Hi Hentries Hc'".
    iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Hentries") as "(Hcs & Hentries)"; first done.
    iApply "Hentries".
    iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Hcs") as "(_ & Hcs)"; first done.
    iApply ("Hcs" with "Hc'").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma waiter۰modelsｰmono γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens gens' cur ws :
    (∀ g, g < cur → gens' !!! g = gens !!! g) →
    (∀ η w, ws !! η = Some w → w.1 ≤ cur) →
    ( [∗ map] η ↦ w ∈ ws,
      waiter۰model γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens cur η w
    ) -∗
    [∗ map] η ↦ w ∈ ws,
      waiter۰model γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens' cur η w.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hgens %Hws Hwaiters".
    iApply (big_sepM_impl with "Hwaiters").
    iIntros "!> %η %w %Hw (%𝑘𝑒𝑦 & %Ψ & Hkey & Hη & H)".
    iExists 𝑘𝑒𝑦, Ψ. iFrame.
    case_decide; first done.
    rewrite Hgens //.
    opose proof* Hws; first done. lia.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma gens۰physｰinsert gens k buckets cs cs' :
    gens !! k = Some (buckets, cs) →
    length cs' = length cs →
    gens۰phys (<[k := (buckets, cs')]> gens) = gens۰phys gens.
  Proof.
    intros Hk Hlen.
    rewrite /gens۰phys list_fmap_insert /= Hlen list_insert_id //.
    rewrite list_lookup_fmap Hk //.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma gens۰stateｰinsert gens k buckets cs cs' cur resizing :
    gens !! k = Some (buckets, cs) →
    length cs' = length cs →
    gens۰state (<[k := (buckets, cs')]> gens) cur resizing = gens۰state gens cur resizing.
  Proof.
    intros Hk Hlen.
    assert (∀ g, (<[k := (buckets, cs')]> gens !!! g).1 = (gens !!! g).1) as Hfst.
    { intros g. rewrite list_lookup_total_insert. case_decide as Hg; last done.
      destruct Hg as (<- & _). rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hk) //.
    }
    assert (∀ g, length (<[k := (buckets, cs')]> gens !!! g).2 = length (gens !!! g).2) as Hsnd.
    { intros g. rewrite list_lookup_total_insert. case_decide as Hg; last done.
      destruct Hg as (<- & _). rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hk) //.
    }
    rewrite /gens۰state !Hfst !Hsnd //.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma big_sepM_fupd_thread {A} E (R : iProp Σ) (P Q : gname → A → iProp Σ) (ws : gmap gname A) :
    □ (∀ η a, ⌜ws !! η = Some a⌝ -∗ R -∗ P η a ={E}=∗ R ∗ Q η a) -∗
    R -∗
    ([∗ map] η ↦ a ∈ ws, P η a) ={E}=∗
      R ∗
      [∗ map] η ↦ a ∈ ws, Q η a.
  Proof.
    iIntros "#H HR HP".
    iInduction ws as [| η a ws Hη] "IH" using map_ind.
    - iFrame. iApply big_sepM_empty. done.
    - rewrite !big_sepM_insert //.
      iDestruct "HP" as "(HPa & HP)".
      iMod ("H" with "[%] HR HPa") as "(HR & HQa)".
      { rewrite lookup_insert_eq //. }
      iMod ("IH" with "[] HR HP") as "($ & $)".
      { iIntros "!> %η' %a' %Hη' HR HP".
        iApply ("H" with "[%] HR HP").
        rewrite lookup_insert_ne //. naive.
      }
      iFrame. done.
  Qed.


  #[local] Definition node۰result node (o : option val) :=
    match o with
    | None =>
        node = §htbl٠bucket٠Nil%V
    | Some v =>
        ∃ key rest,
        node = ‘htbl٠bucket٠Cons[ key, v, rest ]%V
    end.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspecｰbucket equal key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es :
    {{{
      htbl۰valid۰equal key۰model equal ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∗
      entries۰model es
    }}}
      htbl٠bucket٠assoc equal key (bucket۰to_val es.*1)
    {{{
      node
    , RET node;
      ⌜node۰result node (entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es)⌝
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iInduction es as [| ((key', v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es] "IH".
    all: iIntros "%Φ (#Hequal & #Hkey & #Hes) HΦ".
    all: wp۰rec.
    - iSteps.
    - rewrite /entries۰model big_sepL_cons.
      iDestruct "Hes" as "(Hkey' & Hes)".
      wp۰apply+ (wpｰwand with "(Hequal Hkey Hkey')") as (res) "->".
      rewrite /=. case_decide.
      + rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2 //.
        iSteps.
      + rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2 //.
        wp۰pures.
        wp۰apply ("IH" with "[$Hequal $Hkey $Hes] HΦ").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspec equal key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 c :
    c ≠ CellInit →
    {{{
      htbl۰valid۰equal key۰model equal ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∗
      entries۰model (cell۰entries c)
    }}}
      htbl٠bucket٠assoc equal key (cell۰to_val c)
    {{{
      node
    , RET node;
      ⌜node۰result node (entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (cell۰entries c))⌝
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hc %Φ (#Hequal & #Hkey & #Hes) HΦ".
    destruct c as [| es | es]; first done; simpl.
    - iApply (htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspecｰbucket with "[$Hequal $Hkey $Hes] HΦ").
    - wp۰rec.
      wp۰apply+ (htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspecｰbucket with "[$Hequal $Hkey $Hes] HΦ").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠bucket٠filterｰspec (P : val * val * Key → Prop) `{!∀ e, Decision (P e)} (pred : val) es :
    {{{
      □ (
        ∀ key v 𝑘𝑒𝑦,
        ⌜(key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ∈ es⌝ -∗
        WP pred key {{ res,
          ⌜res = #(bool_decide (P (key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦)%core))⌝
        }}
      )
    }}}
      htbl٠bucket٠filter pred (bucket۰to_val es.*1)
    {{{
      RET bucket۰to_val (filter P es).*1;
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iInduction es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦) es] "IH".
    all: iIntros "%Φ #Hpred HΦ".
    all: wp۰rec.
    - iSteps.
    - wp۰pures.
      iDestruct ("Hpred" $! key v 𝑘𝑒𝑦 with "[%]") as "Hpred'"; first set_solver.
      wp۰apply+ (wpｰwand with "Hpred'") as (res) "->".
      rewrite filter_cons.
      case_decide.
      + rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2 //.
        wp۰pures.
        wp۰apply ("IH" with "[]") as "_".
        { iIntros "!> %key' %v' %𝑘𝑒𝑦' %He". iApply "Hpred". iPureIntro. set_solver. }
        iSteps.
      + rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2 //.
        wp۰pures.
        wp۰apply ("IH" with "[] HΦ").
        { iIntros "!> %key' %v' %𝑘𝑒𝑦' %He". iApply "Hpred". iPureIntro. set_solver. }
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠bucket٠mergeｰspec es1 es2 :
    {{{
      True
    }}}
      htbl٠bucket٠merge (bucket۰to_val es1.*1) (bucket۰to_val es2.*1)
    {{{
      RET bucket۰to_val (es2 ++ es1).*1;
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iInduction es2 as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦) es2] "IH".
    all: iIntros "%Φ _ HΦ".
    all: wp۰rec.
    - iSteps.
    - wp۰pures.
      wp۰apply ("IH" with "[//]") as "_".
      iSteps.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma htbl٠buckets٠take₁ｰspec γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets cap buckets' cap' (i : nat) backoff :
    i < cap →
    {{{
      inv' γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 ∗
      gen۰witness γ g buckets cap ∗
      gens۰at γ (S g) buckets' cap' ∗
      backoff۰model backoff
    }}}
      htbl٠buckets٠take₁ #buckets #i backoff
    {{{
      es
    , RET bucket۰to_val es.*1;
      frozen۰elem γ g i es ∗
      entries۰model es ∗
      ⌜entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es⌝
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hi %Φ (#Hinv & (:gen۰witness) & #Hgens_at' & Hbackoff) HΦ".

    iLöb as "HLöb" forall (backoff).

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.

    awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_getｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv") without "Hbackoff HΦ"; first lia.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hgens1_lookup & <-).
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at'") as %(cs' & Hgens1_lookup' & _).
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens1_lookup.
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
    { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
      iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
      iSplitL; last iSteps.
      iFrameSteps.
    }
    iIntros "%𝑣 (%Hlookup & Hmodel)".
    iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
    rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
    apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c & -> & Hcs_lookup).
    simpl in Hcs_lookup.
    pose proof (inv۰pureｰle _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1 Hgens1_lookup') as Hg.
    destruct c as [| es | es].

    - exfalso. by eapply (inv۰pureｰnot_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1 Hgens1_lookup Hg Hcs_lookup).

    - iSplitL. { iFrameSteps. }
      iIntros "!> _ (Hbackoff & HΦ)".
      iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

      iAssert (
        WP
          𝗶𝗳 htbl٠buckets٠cas #buckets #i (bucket۰to_val es.*1) (Val ‘htbl٠bucket٠Resize( bucket۰to_val es.*1 )%V) 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 (
            bucket۰to_val es.*1
          ) 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 (
            htbl٠buckets٠take₁ #buckets #i (backoff٠once backoff)
          )
        {{ Φ }}
      )%I with "[Hbackoff HΦ]" as "H".
      { awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_casｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv") without "Hbackoff HΦ"; first lia.
        iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =2)".
        iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs2 & Hgens2_lookup & Hcs2).
        iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at'") as %(cs2' & Hgens2_lookup' & _).
        iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens2_lookup.
        iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
        { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
          iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, cs2) with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
          rewrite list_insert_id //.
          iSplitL; last iSteps.
          iFrameSteps.
        }
        iIntros "%b %𝑣 (%Hlookup & %Hcas & Hmodel)".
        rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
        apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c & -> & Hcs2_lookup).
        simpl in Hcs2_lookup.
        destruct b.

        - apply cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰbucket in Hcas as (es2 & -> & Hes2).
          pose proof (inv۰pureｰle _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup') as Hg2.
          assert (g = cur2) as ->.
          { destruct (decide (g = cur2)); first done.
            opose proof* (inv۰pure۰old _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 g) as (? & ?); [lia | done | done | done].
          }
          assert (resizing2 = true) as ->.
          { apply lookup_lt_Some in Hgens2_lookup'.
            rewrite (inv۰pure۰length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2) in Hgens2_lookup'.
            destruct resizing2; simpl in *; [done | lia].
          }
          assert (F2 !! (cur2, i) = None) as HF.
          { apply eq_None_not_Some. intros (bucket & Hbucket).
            apply (inv۰pure۰frozen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2) in Hbucket as (gen & es' & Hgen & Hi' & _).
            rewrite Hgens2_lookup in Hgen. injection Hgen as <-.
            simpl in Hi'. congruence.
          }
          iMod (frozenｰinsert cur2 i es2 with "Hfrozen_auth") as "(Hfrozen_auth & #Hfrozen_elem)"; first done.
          iAssert (▷ entries۰model es2)%I as "#Hes2".
          { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup Hcs2_lookup with "Hentries"). }
          pose proof (inv۰pure۰wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ _ Hgens2_lookup _ _ Hcs2_lookup) as Hwf.
          iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es2]> cs2) with "[Hmodel]") as "Harrays".
          { iEval (rewrite Nat2Z.id) in "Hmodel". rewrite /= list_fmap_insert /= Hes2 //. }
          iSplitL.
          { iModIntro. iNext.
            iExists (<[cur2 := (buckets, <[i := CellFrozen es2]> cs2)]> gens2), cur2, true, m2, (<[(cur2, i) := entries۰encode es2]> F2), I2, ws2.
            rewrite (gens۰stateｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup); first rewrite length_insert //.
            rewrite /gens۰auth /gens۰auth' (gens۰physｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup); first rewrite length_insert //.
            iFrame "∗#".
            iSplitR.
            { iApply big_sepM_insert; first done. iFrame "#". }
            iSplitR.
            { iApply (entries۰modelsｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ (CellFrozen es2) Hgens2_lookup Hcs2_lookup with "Hentries Hes2"). }
            iSplitR.
            { iPureIntro. apply inv۰pureｰfreeze; done. }
            iApply (waiter۰modelsｰmono with "Hwaiters").
            - intros g' Hg'. rewrite list_lookup_total_insert_ne //. lia.
            - apply (inv۰pure۰waiters _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2).
          }
          iIntros "!> H£ (Hbackoff & HΦ)".
          iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes2") as "#Hes2'".
          wp۰pures.
          rewrite -Hes2.
          iApply ("HΦ" $! es2).
          rewrite Hcs2 /= in Hwf.
          iFrame "#". done.

        - iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, cs2) with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
          rewrite list_insert_id //.
          iSplitL. { iFrameSteps. }
          iIntros "!> _ (Hbackoff & HΦ)".

          wp۰pures.
          wp۰apply (backoff٠onceｰspec with "Hbackoff") as (backoff') "Hbackoff".
          wp۰apply ("HLöb" with "Hbackoff HΦ").
      }
      destruct es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦) es]; wp۰pures; iApply "H".

    - iAssert (▷ entries۰model es)%I as "#Hes".
      { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens1_lookup Hcs_lookup with "Hentries"). }
      opose proof* (proj2 (inv۰pure۰frozen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1 g i (entries۰encode es))) as HF.
      { eexists _, es. done. }
      iDestruct (big_sepM_lookup with "Hfrozen_elems") as "#Hfrozen_elem"; first done.
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1 _ _ Hgens1_lookup _ _ Hcs_lookup) as Hwf.
      simpl in Hwf.
      iSplitL. { iFrameSteps. }
      iIntros "!> H£ (Hbackoff & HΦ)".
      iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes") as "#Hes'".
      wp۰pures.
      iApply ("HΦ" $! es).
      iFrame "#". done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠buckets٠takeｰspec γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets cap buckets' cap' (i : nat) :
    i < cap →
    {{{
      inv' γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 ∗
      gen۰witness γ g buckets cap ∗
      gens۰at γ (S g) buckets' cap'
    }}}
      htbl٠buckets٠take #buckets #i
    {{{
      es
    , RET bucket۰to_val es.*1;
      frozen۰elem γ g i es ∗
      entries۰model es ∗
      ⌜entries۰wf 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap i es⌝
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hi %Φ (#Hinv & #Hwitness & #Hgens_at') HΦ".

    wp۰rec.
    wp۰apply+ (htbl٠buckets٠take₁ｰspec with "[$Hinv $Hwitness $Hgens_at'] HΦ"); first done.
    iApply backoff٠defaultｰspec.
  Qed.


  #[local] Definition pending۰proof γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g (cap cap' : nat) j es' : iProp Σ :=
    ( ⌜(cap' = 2 * cap)%nat⌝ ∗
      ∃ es,
      frozen۰elem γ g (j `mod` cap) es ∗
      ⌜es' = split۰entries 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap (bool_decide (cap ≤ j)) es⌝
    ) ∨ (
      ⌜(cap = 2 * cap')%nat⌝ ∗
      ∃ es1 es2,
      frozen۰elem γ g j es1 ∗
      frozen۰elem γ g (j + cap') es2 ∗
      ⌜es' = es2 ++ es1⌝
    ).

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠buckets٠cas_initｰspec γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets cap buckets' cap' (j : nat) es' :
    j < cap' →
    {{{
      inv' γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 ∗
      gen۰witness γ g buckets cap ∗
      gen۰witness γ (S g) buckets' cap' ∗
      entries۰model es' ∗
      pending۰proof γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g cap cap' j es'
    }}}
      htbl٠buckets٠cas_init #buckets' #j (bucket۰to_val es'.*1)
    {{{
      RET ();
      inited۰elem γ (S g) j
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hj %Φ (#Hinv & (:gen۰witness) & (:gen۰witness =next) & #Hes' & Hproof) HΦ".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.

    awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_getｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv_next") without "Hproof HΦ"; first lia.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at_next") as %(cs' & Hgens1_lookup' & <-).
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens1_lookup'.
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
    { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
      iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
      iSplitL; last iSteps.
      iFrameSteps.
    }
    iIntros "%𝑣 (%Hlookup & Hmodel)".
    iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
    rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
    apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c & -> & Hcs'_lookup).
    simpl in Hcs'_lookup.
    destruct (cellｰinitｰcases c) as [-> | Hc].

    - iSplitL. { iFrameSteps. }
      iIntros "!> _ (Hproof & HΦ)".
      iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

      wp۰pures.

      awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_casｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv_next") without "HΦ"; first lia.
      iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =2)".
      iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at_next") as %(cs2' & Hgens2_lookup' & Hcs2').
      iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs2 & Hgens2_lookup & Hcs2).
      iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens2_lookup'.
      iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
      { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
        iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets', cs2') with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
        rewrite list_insert_id //.
        iFrame "Hproof". iFrameSteps.
      }
      iIntros "%b %𝑣 (%Hlookup & %Hcas & Hmodel)".
