      rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
      apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c2 & -> & Hcs2'_lookup).
      simpl in Hcs2'_lookup.
      destruct b.

      + apply cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰInit in Hcas as ->.
        assert (g = cur2 ∧ resizing2 = true) as (-> & ->).
        { destruct (decide (S g ≤ cur2)).
          - exfalso. by eapply (inv۰pureｰnot_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup').
          - pose proof (lookup_lt_Some _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup') as Hlt.
            rewrite (inv۰pure۰length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2) in Hlt.
            destruct resizing2; simpl in Hlt; [split; [lia | done] | lia].
        }
        pose proof (inv۰pure۰pending _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ _ ltac:(done) Hgens2_lookup Hgens2_lookup') as Hpending.
        simpl in Hpending.
        pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).
        iAssert ⌜cells۰pending 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cs2 (<[j := CellActive es']> cs2')⌝%I as %Hpending'.
        { iDestruct "Hproof" as "[(%Hcap & %es & Hfrozen_elem & ->) | (%Hcap & %es1 & %es2 & Hfrozen_elem1 & Hfrozen_elem2 & ->)]".
          - iDestruct (frozen۰elemｰvalid with "Hfrozen_auth Hfrozen_elem") as %Hfrozen.
            apply (inv۰pure۰frozen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2) in Hfrozen as (gen & es0 & Hgen & Hes0 & Hencode).
            rewrite Hgens2_lookup in Hgen. injection Hgen as <-.
            apply (inj _) in Hencode as ->.
            iPureIntro. apply cells۰pendingｰinsert; first done.
            + intros _. right. exists es. rewrite Hcs2. done.
            + intros Hlen. lia.
          - iDestruct (frozen۰elemｰvalid with "Hfrozen_auth Hfrozen_elem1") as %Hfrozen1.
            iDestruct (frozen۰elemｰvalid with "Hfrozen_auth Hfrozen_elem2") as %Hfrozen2.
            apply (inv۰pure۰frozen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2) in Hfrozen1 as (gen1 & es1' & Hgen1 & Hes1 & Hencode1).
            apply (inv۰pure۰frozen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2) in Hfrozen2 as (gen2 & es2' & Hgen2 & Hes2 & Hencode2).
            rewrite Hgens2_lookup in Hgen1. injection Hgen1 as <-.
            rewrite Hgens2_lookup in Hgen2. injection Hgen2 as <-.
            apply (inj _) in Hencode1 as ->.
            apply (inj _) in Hencode2 as ->.
            iPureIntro. apply cells۰pendingｰinsert; first done.
            + intros Hlen. lia.
            + intros _. right. exists es1, es2. rewrite Hcs2'. done.
        }
        iMod (initedｰinsert (S cur2) j with "Hinited_auth") as "(Hinited_auth & #Hinited_elem)".
        iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs2') with "[Hmodel]") as "Harrays".
        { iEval (rewrite Nat2Z.id) in "Hmodel". rewrite /= list_fmap_insert //. }
        iSplitL.
        { iModIntro. iNext.
          iExists (<[S cur2 := (buckets', <[j := CellActive es']> cs2')]> gens2), cur2, true, m2, F2, ({[(S cur2, j)]} ∪ I2), ws2.
          rewrite (gens۰stateｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup'); first rewrite length_insert //.
          rewrite /gens۰auth /gens۰auth' (gens۰physｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup'); first rewrite length_insert //.
          iFrame "∗#".
          iSplitR.
          { iApply (entries۰modelsｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ (CellActive es') Hgens2_lookup' Hcs2'_lookup with "Hentries Hes'"). }
          iSplitR.
          { iPureIntro. eapply inv۰pureｰinit; done. }
          iApply (waiter۰modelsｰmono with "Hwaiters").
          - intros g' Hg'. rewrite list_lookup_total_insert_ne //. lia.
          - apply (inv۰pure۰waiters _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2).
        }
        iIntros "!> _ HΦ".

        wp۰pures.
        iApply "HΦ". done.

      + assert (c2 ≠ CellInit) as Hc2.
        { intros ->. cbn in Hcas. done. }
        iMod (initedｰinsert (S g) j with "Hinited_auth") as "(Hinited_auth & #Hinited_elem)".
        pose proof (inv۰pureｰinited _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup' Hcs2'_lookup Hc2) as Hinv2'.
        iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets', cs2') with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
        rewrite list_insert_id //.
        iSplitL. { iFrameSteps. }
        iIntros "!> _ HΦ".

        wp۰pures.
        iApply "HΦ". done.

    - iMod (initedｰinsert (S g) j with "Hinited_auth") as "(Hinited_auth & #Hinited_elem)".
      pose proof (inv۰pureｰinited _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1 Hgens1_lookup' Hcs'_lookup Hc) as Hinv1'.
      iSplitL. { iFrameSteps. }
      iIntros "!> _ (Hproof & HΦ)".

      wp۰equal as _ | Hsuc.
      + wp۰pures.
        iApply "HΦ". done.
      + apply cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰInit in Hsuc. done.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelｰfilter (P : val * val * Key → Prop) `{!∀ e, Decision (P e)} es :
    entries۰model es ⊢
    entries۰model (filter P es).
  Proof.
    rewrite /entries۰model.
    induction es as [| e es IH]; first iSteps.
    rewrite filter_cons big_sepL_cons.
    iIntros "(He & Hes)".
    case_decide.
    - rewrite big_sepL_cons. iFrame. iApply (IH with "Hes").
    - iApply (IH with "Hes").
  Qed.
  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelｰapp es1 es2 :
    entries۰model es1 -∗
    entries۰model es2 -∗
    entries۰model (es1 ++ es2).
  Proof.
    rewrite /entries۰model big_sepL_app. iSteps.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠split_bucketsｰspec γ ι s g buckets cap buckets' cap' (n : nat) (step : Z) :
    cap' = 2 * cap →
    Z.Odd step →
    {{{
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      state۰witness γ s g buckets cap (Some (buckets', cap')) ∗
      [∗ list] a ∈ seq 1 n,
        inited۰elem γ (S g) ₊((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺cap) ∗
        inited۰elem γ (S g) (₊((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺cap) + cap)
    }}}
      htbl٠split_buckets γ s #buckets' #(⁺cap - 1) #((⁺n * step) `mod` ⁺cap) #step
    {{{
      b
    , RET #b;
      if b then
        ∀ j,
        ⌜j < cap'⌝ -∗
        inited۰elem γ (S g) j
      else
        True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros (-> Hstep) "%Φ ((:inv) & #Hwitness & #Hinited) HΦ".
    iDestruct "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    iDestruct "Ho" as "((:gen۰witness =next) & %Hcaps)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).

    iLöb as "HLöb" forall (n) "Hinited".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    assert (Z.land ((⁺n * step) `mod` ⁺cap + step) (⁺cap - 1) = (⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap)%Z as ->.
    { rewrite Z_land_pow2_pred // Zplus_mod_idemp_l. f_equal. lia. }
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound (⁺(S n) * step) ⁺cap ltac:(lia)) as Hi.
    set i := ₊((⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap).
    assert ((⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap = ⁺i)%Z as Hi' by lia.
    rewrite Hi'.
    rewrite /state۰to_val /status۰to_val.
    wp۰pures.

    wp۰apply (htbl٠buckets٠takeｰspec _ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets cap buckets' (2 * cap) i with "[]") as (es) "(#Hfrozen & #Hes & %Hwf)"; first lia.
    { iFrameSteps. }
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (array٠sizeｰspecｰinv with "Harray_inv") as "_".
    wp۰pures.

    iAssert (
      ∀ c : Z,
      □ (
        ∀ key v 𝑘𝑒𝑦,
        ⌜(key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ∈ es⌝ -∗
        WP (𝗳𝘂𝗻 "key" -> γ.{hash} "key" 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 #⁺cap == #c)%V key {{ res,
          ⌜res = #(bool_decide (Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 𝑘𝑒𝑦) ⁺cap = c))⌝
        }}
      )
    )%I as "#Hpred".
    { iIntros "%c !> %key %v %𝑘𝑒𝑦 %Hin".
      iDestruct (big_sepL_elem_of with "Hes") as "Hkey"; first done.
      wp۰pures. wp۰load.
      wp۰apply+ (wpｰwand with "(Hvalid_hash Hkey)") as (res) "->".
      iSteps.
    }
    wp۰bind (htbl٠bucket٠filter _ _)%E.
    iApply (htbl٠bucket٠filterｰspec (λ e, Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 e.2) ⁺cap = 0)%Z _ es).
    { iApply ("Hpred" $! 0%Z). }
    iIntros "!> _".
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰bind (htbl٠bucket٠filter _ _)%E.
    iApply (htbl٠bucket٠filterｰspec (λ e, Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 e.2) ⁺cap = ⁺cap)%Z _ es).
    { iApply ("Hpred" $! ⁺cap). }
    iIntros "!> _".
    wp۰pures.

    wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰load.
    iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
    iModIntro.
    iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

    wp۰equal as _ | _; wp۰pures.

    - iApply "HΦ". done.

    - wp۰apply (htbl٠buckets٠cas_initｰspec _ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets cap buckets' (2 * cap) i (filter (λ e, Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 e.2) ⁺cap = 0%Z) es) with "[]") as "#Hinited1"; first lia.
      { iFrame "#".
        iSplit; first done.
        iSplit; first (iPureIntro; apply is_pow2ｰdouble; done).
        iSplit; first iApply (entries۰modelｰfilter with "Hes").
        iLeft. iSplit; first done.
        iExists es. rewrite Nat.mod_small; first lia. iFrame "#". iPureIntro.
        rewrite /split۰entries bool_decide_eq_false_2 //. lia.
      }
      wp۰pures.
      rewrite -Nat2Z.inj_add.
      wp۰apply (htbl٠buckets٠cas_initｰspec _ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets cap buckets' (2 * cap) (i + cap) (filter (λ e, Z.land (𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 e.2) ⁺cap = ⁺cap) es) with "[]") as "#Hinited2"; first lia.
      { iFrame "#".
        iSplit; first done.
        iSplit; first (iPureIntro; apply is_pow2ｰdouble; done).
        iSplit; first iApply (entries۰modelｰfilter with "Hes").
        iLeft. iSplit; first done.
        iExists es. replace (i + cap) with (i + 1 * cap) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add Nat.mod_small; first lia. iFrame "#". iPureIntro.
        rewrite /split۰entries bool_decide_eq_true_2 //. lia.
      }
      iAssert (
        [∗ list] a ∈ seq 1 (S n),
          inited۰elem γ (S g) ₊((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺cap) ∗
          inited۰elem γ (S g) (₊((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺cap) + cap)
      )%I as "#Hinited'".
      { rewrite seq_S big_sepL_app /=. iFrame "#". }
      wp۰pures.
      case_bool_decide as Hi0; wp۰pures.

      + iApply "HΦ".
        iIntros "!> %j %Hj".
        assert ((⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap = 0)%Z as Hzero by lia.
        destruct (Z_coverage cap step (S n) Hpow2 Hstep ltac:(lia) Hzero ⁺(j `mod` cap)) as (a & Ha & Haj).
        { pose proof (Nat.mod_upper_bound j cap ltac:(lia)). lia. }
        iDestruct (big_sepL_elem_of _ _ a with "Hinited'") as "(Hinited_lo & Hinited_hi)".
        { apply elem_of_seq. lia. }
        iEval (rewrite Haj Nat2Z.id) in "Hinited_lo".
        iEval (rewrite Haj Nat2Z.id) in "Hinited_hi".
        destruct (decide (j < cap)).
        * assert (j `mod` cap = j) as Hjm by (apply Nat.mod_small; lia).
          iEval (rewrite Hjm) in "Hinited_lo".
          iFrame "Hinited_lo".
        * assert (j `mod` cap + cap = j) as Hjm.
          { pose proof (Nat.div_mod j cap ltac:(lia)).
            assert (j `div` cap = 1) as Hdiv by (symmetry; apply Nat.div_unique with (j - cap); lia).
            lia.
          }
          iEval (rewrite Hjm) in "Hinited_hi".
          iFrame "Hinited_hi".

      + rewrite -Hi'.
        iApply ("HLöb" $! (S n) with "HΦ Hinited'").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠merge_bucketsｰspec γ ι s g buckets cap buckets' cap' (n : nat) (step : Z) :
    cap = 2 * cap' →
    Z.Odd step →
    {{{
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      state۰witness γ s g buckets cap (Some (buckets', cap')) ∗
      [∗ list] a ∈ seq 1 n,
        inited۰elem γ (S g) ₊((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺cap')
    }}}
      htbl٠merge_buckets γ s #buckets' #(⁺cap' - 1) #((⁺n * step) `mod` ⁺cap') #step
    {{{
      b
    , RET #b;
      if b then
        ∀ j,
        ⌜j < cap'⌝ -∗
        inited۰elem γ (S g) j
      else
        True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros (-> Hstep) "%Φ ((:inv) & #Hwitness & #Hinited) HΦ".
    iDestruct "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    iDestruct "Ho" as "((:gen۰witness =next) & %Hcaps)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2_next).

    iLöb as "HLöb" forall (n) "Hinited".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    assert (Z.land ((⁺n * step) `mod` ⁺cap' + step) (⁺cap' - 1) = (⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap')%Z as ->.
    { rewrite Z_land_pow2_pred // Zplus_mod_idemp_l. f_equal. lia. }
    pose proof (Z.mod_pos_bound (⁺(S n) * step) ⁺cap' ltac:(lia)) as Hi.
    set i := ₊((⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap').
    assert ((⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap' = ⁺i)%Z as Hi' by lia.
    rewrite Hi'.
    rewrite /state۰to_val /status۰to_val.
    wp۰pures.

    wp۰apply (htbl٠buckets٠takeｰspec _ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets (2 * cap') buckets' cap' i with "[]") as (es1) "(#Hfrozen1 & #Hes1 & _)"; first lia.
    { iFrameSteps. }
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (array٠sizeｰspecｰinv with "Harray_inv_next") as "_".
    wp۰pures.
    rewrite -Nat2Z.inj_add.
    wp۰apply (htbl٠buckets٠takeｰspec _ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets (2 * cap') buckets' cap' (i + cap') with "[]") as (es2) "(#Hfrozen2 & #Hes2 & _)"; first lia.
    { iFrameSteps. }
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (htbl٠bucket٠mergeｰspec es1 es2 with "[//]") as "_".
    wp۰pures.

    wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰load.
    iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
    iModIntro.
    iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

    wp۰equal as _ | _; wp۰pures.

    - iApply "HΦ". done.

    - wp۰apply (htbl٠buckets٠cas_initｰspec _ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 g buckets (2 * cap') buckets' cap' i (es2 ++ es1) with "[]") as "#Hinited1"; first lia.
      { iFrame "#".
        iSplit; first (iPureIntro; apply is_pow2ｰdouble; done).
        iSplit; first done.
        iRight. iSplit; done.
      }
      iAssert (
        [∗ list] a ∈ seq 1 (S n),
          inited۰elem γ (S g) ₊((⁺a * step) `mod` ⁺cap')
      )%I as "#Hinited'".
      { rewrite seq_S big_sepL_app /=. iFrame "#". }
      wp۰pures.
      case_bool_decide as Hi0; wp۰pures.

      + iApply "HΦ".
        iIntros "!> %j %Hj".
        assert ((⁺(S n) * step) `mod` ⁺cap' = 0)%Z as Hzero by lia.
        destruct (Z_coverage cap' step (S n) Hpow2_next Hstep ltac:(lia) Hzero ⁺j) as (a & Ha & Haj); first lia.
        iDestruct (big_sepL_elem_of _ _ a with "Hinited'") as "Hinited_a".
        { apply elem_of_seq. lia. }
        iEval (rewrite Haj Nat2Z.id) in "Hinited_a".
        iFrame "Hinited_a".

      + rewrite -Hi'.
        iApply ("HLöb" $! (S n) with "HΦ Hinited'").
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma htbl٠finish_asｰspec γ ι s g buckets cap o :
    {{{
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      state۰witness γ s g buckets cap o
    }}}
      htbl٠finish_as γ s
    {{{
      RET ();
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hwitness) HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".

    iLöb as "HLöb" forall (s g buckets cap o Φ) "Hwitness".

    iAssert (
      □ (
        ∀ Ψ,
        ▷ (True -∗ Ψ ()%V) -∗
        WP htbl٠finish γ {{ Ψ }}
      )
    )%I as "#Hfinish".
    { iIntros "!> %Ψ HΨ".

      wp۰rec.

      wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
      iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
      wp۰load.
      iDestruct (state۰witnessｰget with "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays") as "(Hgens_auth & Hcurrent_auth & Harrays & %buckets1 & %cap1 & %o1 & #Hwitness1 & _)"; first done.
      iSplitR "HΨ". { iFrameSteps. }
      iModIntro.

      iApply ("HLöb" with "HΨ Hwitness1").
    }

    wp۰rec.
    iPoseProof "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    destruct o as [(buckets', cap') |].

    - iDestruct "Ho" as "((:gen۰witness =next) & %Hcaps)".
      rewrite /state۰to_val /status۰to_val.
      wp۰pures.
      wp۰bind (htbl٠buckets٠size _)%E.
      iApply (array٠sizeｰspecｰinv with "Harray_inv").
      iIntros "!> _".
      wp۰pures.
      wp۰bind (htbl٠buckets٠size _)%E.
      iApply (array٠sizeｰspecｰinv with "Harray_inv_next").
      iIntros "!> _".
      wp۰pures.
      wp۰bind (random٠bits _)%E.
      iApply random٠bitsｰspec. iIntros "%k".
      wp۰pures.

      wp۰bind (𝗶𝗳 #(bool_decide (⁺cap < ⁺cap')) 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 _ 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 _)%E.
      iApply (wpｰwand (λ res,
        ∃ b,
        ⌜res = #b⌝ ∗
        if b then
          ∀ j,
          ⌜j < cap'⌝ -∗
          inited۰elem γ (S g) j
        else
          True
      )%I with "[]").
      { case_bool_decide as Hlt; wp۰pures.
        - assert (cap' = 2 * cap) as -> by lia.
          wp۰bind (htbl٠split_buckets _ _ _ _ _ _)%E.
          iApply (htbl٠split_bucketsｰspec γ _ _ g buckets cap buckets' (2 * cap) 0 (Z.lor k 1) with "[]"); [done | apply Z_lor_1_odd | |].
          { iFrame "#". iSteps. }
          iSteps.
        - assert (cap = 2 * cap') as -> by lia.
          wp۰bind (htbl٠merge_buckets _ _ _ _ _ _)%E.
          iApply (htbl٠merge_bucketsｰspec γ _ _ g buckets (2 * cap') buckets' cap' 0 (Z.lor k 1) with "[]"); [done | apply Z_lor_1_odd | |].
          { iFrame "#". iSteps. }
          iSteps.
      }
      iIntros "%res (%b & -> & Hb)".
      destruct b; wp۰pures; last first.
      { iApply ("Hfinish" with "[HΦ]"). iSteps. }

      wp۰bind (𝗰𝗮𝘀 _ _ _)%E.
      iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =2)".
      wp۰cas as _ | Hsuc.

      + iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
        iModIntro.

        wp۰pures.
        iApply ("Hfinish" with "[HΦ]"). iSteps.

      + iDestruct (state۰witnessｰsimilar _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g buckets cap (Some (buckets', cap')) Hinv2 Hsuc with "Hgens_auth []") as %(<- & Hresizing2).
        { iFrame "#". iSteps. }
        destruct resizing2; last done.
        iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hgens2_lookup & <-).
        iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at_next") as %(cs' & Hgens2_lookup' & <-).
        iAssert ⌜∀ j c', cs' !! j = Some c' → c' ≠ CellInit⌝%I as %Hinit.
        { iIntros (j c' Hj).
          iDestruct ("Hb" $! j with "[%]") as "Hinited_elem".
          { eapply lookup_lt_Some. done. }
          iDestruct (inited۰elemｰvalid with "Hinited_auth Hinited_elem") as %(gen & c & Hgen & Hc & Hc')%(inv۰pure۰inited _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2).
          rewrite Hgens2_lookup' in Hgen. injection Hgen as <-.
          rewrite Hj in Hc. injection Hc as <-.
          done.
        }
        destruct (inv۰pureｰinstall _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup Hgens2_lookup' Hinit) as (Hinv2' & Hlookups).
        iMod (currentｰupdate (S g) with "Hcurrent_auth") as "Hcurrent_auth"; first lia.
        iMod (big_sepM_fupd_thread _ (model₂ γ m2) (waiter۰model γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens2 g) (waiter۰model γ 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 gens2 (S g)) ws2 with "[] Hmodel₂ Hwaiters") as "(Hmodel₂ & Hwaiters)".
        { iIntros "!> %η %w %Hw Hmodel₂ (%𝑘𝑒𝑦 & %Ψ & #Hkey & #Hη & HΨ)".
          pose proof (inv۰pure۰waiters _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ _ Hw).
          assert (w.1 ≠ S g) as Hne by lia.
          destruct (decide (w.1 = g)) as [Hw1 | Hw1].
          - iMod "HΨ" as "(%m & Hmodel₁ & _ & HΨ)".
            iDestruct (modelｰagree with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %->.
            iMod ("HΨ" with "Hmodel₁") as "HΨ".
            iFrame "Hmodel₂". iExists 𝑘𝑒𝑦, Ψ. iFrame "#".
            rewrite (decide_False _ _ Hne) Hw1 (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup) /=.
            rewrite (inv۰pure۰model _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ Hgens2_lookup) //.
          - iFrame "Hmodel₂". iExists 𝑘𝑒𝑦, Ψ. iFrame "#".
            rewrite (decide_False _ _ Hne). iFrame. done.
        }
        iSplitR "HΦ".
        { iModIntro. iNext.
          iExists gens2, (S g), false, m2, F2, I2, ws2.
          rewrite /gens۰state (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup') /=.
          iFrameSteps.
        }
        iModIntro.

        wp۰pures.
        iApply "HΦ". done.

    - rewrite /state۰to_val /status۰to_val.
      wp۰pures.
      iApply "HΦ". done.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠finishｰspec γ ι :
    {{{
      htbl۰inv γ ι
    }}}
      htbl٠finish γ
    {{{
      RET ();
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ #Hhtbl HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".

    wp۰rec.

    wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰load.
    iDestruct (state۰witnessｰget with "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays") as "(Hgens_auth & Hcurrent_auth & Harrays & %buckets1 & %cap1 & %o1 & #Hwitness1 & _)"; first done.
    iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
    iModIntro.

    wp۰apply (htbl٠finish_asｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hwitness1] HΦ").
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma htbl٠resize₁ｰspec γ ι s g buckets cap (new_cap : nat) :
    is_pow2 new_cap →
    new_cap = 2 * cap ∨ cap = 2 * new_cap →
    {{{
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      state۰witness γ s g buckets cap None
    }}}
      htbl٠resize₁ γ s #new_cap
    {{{
      RET ();
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hpow2' %Hrel %Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hwitness) HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".
    iPoseProof "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2').

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (array٠makeｰspec with "[//]") as (t) "(_ & Hnew)".
    iDestruct (array۰modelｰloc with "Hnew") as %(new & ->).
    rewrite Nat2Z.id.
    iDestruct (array۰modelｰtoｰinv with "Hnew") as "#Hnew_inv".
    rewrite length_replicate.
    rewrite /state۰to_val /status۰to_val.
    wp۰pures.

    wp۰bind (𝗰𝗮𝘀 _ _ _)%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰cas as _ | Hsuc.

    - iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
      iModIntro.

      wp۰pures.
      iApply "HΦ". done.

    - iDestruct (state۰witnessｰsimilar _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g buckets cap None Hinv1 Hsuc with "Hgens_auth []") as %(<- & Hresizing1).
      { iFrame "#". iSteps. }
      destruct resizing1; first by destruct Hresizing1.
      iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hgens1_lookup & <-).
      iAssert ⌜new ∉ gens1.*1⌝%I as %Hfresh.
      { iIntros (Hin).
        apply list_elem_of_fmap in Hin as ((buckets0 & cs0) & -> & Hin).
        apply list_elem_of_lookup in Hin as (g0 & Hg0).
        iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & _)"; first exact Hg0.
        iDestruct (array۰modelｰne with "Hnew Hmodel") as %?; first (rewrite length_replicate; lia).
        done.
      }
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1) as Hlength. simpl in Hlength. rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Hlength.
      iMod (gensｰupdate (new, replicate new_cap CellInit) with "Hgens_auth") as "(Hgens_auth & #Hgens_at_new)".
      rewrite Hlength /= length_replicate.
      iSplitR "HΦ".
      { iModIntro. iNext.
        iExists (gens1 ++ [(new, replicate new_cap CellInit)]), g, true, m1, F1, I1, ws1.
        rewrite /gens۰state lookup_total_app_l; first lia.
        rewrite lookup_total_app_r; first lia.
        replace (S g - length gens1) with 0 by lia.
        rewrite /= (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hgens1_lookup) /= length_replicate.
        rewrite big_sepL_snoc big_sepL_snoc /= fmap_replicate.
        iFrame "∗#".
        iSplitR.
        { iApply big_sepL_intro. iIntros "!> %k %c %Hc".
          apply lookup_replicate in Hc as (-> & _).
          rewrite /entries۰model //.
        }
        iSplitR.
        { iPureIntro. eapply inv۰pureｰresize; done. }
        iApply (waiter۰modelsｰmono with "Hwaiters").
        - intros g' Hg'. rewrite lookup_total_app_l //. lia.
        - apply (inv۰pure۰waiters _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv1).
      }
      iModIntro.

      wp۰pures.
      wp۰apply (htbl٠finish_asｰspec _ _ _ g buckets (length cs) (Some (new, new_cap)) with "[$Hhtbl] HΦ").
      iFrame "#". iSteps.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠resizeｰspec γ ι s g buckets cap o (delta : Z) :
    {{{
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      state۰witness γ s g buckets cap o
    }}}
      htbl٠resize γ s #delta
    {{{
      RET ();
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hwitness) HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".
    iPoseProof "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    wp۰load.
    wp۰bind (atomic_array٠size _)%E.
    iApply (array٠sizeｰtype itype۰int with "Hsizes"). iIntros "!> _".
    wp۰bind (domain٠self_index _)%E.
    iApply domain٠self_indexｰspec. iIntros "%k !>".
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰load.
    pose proof (Z.rem_bound_pos ⁺k ⁺sz ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia)) as Hrem.
    wp۰bind (atomic_array٠unsafe_faa _ _ _)%E.
    iApply (array٠unsafe_faaｰtype with "Hsizes"); first lia. iIntros "!> %n _".
    wp۰pures.
    rewrite /state۰to_val.
    destruct o as [(buckets', cap') |]; rewrite /status۰to_val; wp۰pures.

    - iApply "HΦ". done.

    - wp۰bind (random٠bits _)%E.
      iApply random٠bitsｰspec. iIntros "%r".
      wp۰pures.
      case_bool_decide; wp۰pures; last (iApply "HΦ"; done).

      wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
      iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
      wp۰load.
      iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
      iModIntro.
      iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

      wp۰equal as _ | _; wp۰pures; first (iApply "HΦ"; done).
      wp۰load.
      wp۰bind (atomic_array٠sum _)%E.
      iApply (array٠sumｰtype with "Hsizes"). iIntros "!> %total _".
      wp۰pures.
      wp۰bind (htbl٠buckets٠size _)%E.
      iApply (array٠sizeｰspecｰinv with "Harray_inv"). iIntros "!> _".
      destruct htbl٠max_bucketsｰspec as (mx & ->).
      rewrite htbl٠min_bucketsｰspec.
      wp۰pures.

      iAssert (
        □ (
          ∀ Ψ,
          (True -∗ Ψ ()%V) -∗
          WP
            𝗶𝗳 (𝗶𝗳 16 < #⁺cap 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 3 * #total < #⁺cap 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 false) 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 (
              htbl٠resize₁ γ (#buckets, #(⁺cap - 1), §htbl٠Normal)%V (#⁺cap 𝗹𝘀𝗿 1)
            ) 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 (
              ()
            )
          {{ Ψ }}
        )
      )%I as "#Hshrink".
      { iIntros "!> %Ψ HΨ".
        wp۰pures.
        case_bool_decide as Hc1; wp۰pures; last (iApply "HΨ"; done).
        case_bool_decide as Hc2; wp۰pures; last (iApply "HΨ"; done).
        destruct (is_pow2ｰhalf cap Hpow2) as (Hpow2' & Hhalf); first lia.
        assert (Z.shiftr ⁺cap 1 = ⁺(cap / 2))%Z as ->.
        { rewrite Z.shiftr_div_pow2; first lia. rewrite Nat2Z.inj_div //. }
        iApply (htbl٠resize₁ｰspec _ _ _ g buckets cap (cap / 2) with "[] [HΨ]"); [done | right; done | | iSteps].
        iFrame "#". iSteps.
      }
      case_bool_decide as Hc1; last (wp۰pure; wp۰pure; iApply ("Hshrink" with "HΦ")).
      wp۰pures.
      case_bool_decide as Hc2; last (wp۰pure; iApply ("Hshrink" with "HΦ")).
      wp۰pures.
      assert (Z.shiftl ⁺cap 1 = ⁺(2 * cap))%Z as ->.
      { rewrite Z.shiftl_mul_pow2; lia. }
      iApply (htbl٠resize₁ｰspec _ _ _ g buckets cap (2 * cap) with "[] HΦ"); [apply is_pow2ｰdouble; done | left; done |].
      iFrame "#". iSteps.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma htbl٠indexｰspec γ hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 buckets cap o key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    is_pow2 cap →
    {{{
      γ.(htbl۰name۰self).[hash] ↦□ hash ∗
      htbl۰valid۰hash key۰model hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    }}}
      htbl٠index γ (state۰to_val buckets cap o) key
    {{{
      RET #(entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦);
      True
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Hpow2 %Φ (#Hself_hash & #Hvalid_hash & #Hkey) HΦ".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).

    wp۰rec.
    rewrite /state۰to_val.
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰load.
    wp۰apply+ (wpｰwand with "(Hvalid_hash Hkey)") as (res) "->".
    wp۰pures.
    rewrite Z_land_pow2_pred // -entries۰indexｰZ //.
    iApply "HΦ". done.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma htbl٠add_auxｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 v (backoff : val) :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∗
      backoff۰model backoff
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠add_aux γ key v backoff
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ (if decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∈ dom m) then m else <[𝑘𝑒𝑦 := v]> m)
    | RET #(bool_decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∉ dom m));
      True
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey & Hbackoff) HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".

    iLöb as "HLöb" forall (backoff).

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.

    wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰load.
    iDestruct (state۰witnessｰget with "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays") as "(Hgens_auth & Hcurrent_auth & Harrays & %buckets & %cap & %o & #Hwitness & _)"; first done.
    iSplitR "Hbackoff HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
    iModIntro.
    iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

    iPoseProof "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (htbl٠indexｰspec with "[$Hself_hash $Hvalid_hash $Hkey]") as "_"; first done.
    pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ltac:(lia)) as Hi.
    set i := entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
    rewrite /state۰to_val.
    wp۰pures.

    awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_getｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv") without "Hbackoff"; first lia.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =2)".
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hgens2_lookup & <-).
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens2_lookup.
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
    { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
      iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
      iSplitL "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Hmodel₂ Hself_state Hfrozen_auth Hinited_auth Hwaiters_auth Harrays Hwaiters"; last iSteps.
      iFrameSteps.
    }
    iIntros "%𝑣 (%Hlookup & Hmodel)".
    iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
    rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
    apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c & -> & Hcs_lookup).
    simpl in Hcs_lookup.
    iDestruct (current۰lbｰvalid with "Hcurrent_auth Hcurrent_lb") as %Hg.
    destruct c as [| es | es].

    - exfalso. by eapply (inv۰pureｰnot_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup Hg Hcs_lookup).

    - assert (cur1 = cur2) as <-.
      { destruct (decide (cur1 = cur2)); first done.
        opose proof* (inv۰pure۰old _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 cur1) as (? & ?); [lia | done | done | done].
      }
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰model _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ Hgens2_lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦) as Hm.
      rewrite /cells۰lookup /= (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs_lookup) /= in Hm.
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ _ Hgens2_lookup _ _ Hcs_lookup) as Hwf.
      simpl in Hwf.
      iAssert (▷ entries۰model es)%I as "#Hes".
      { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup Hcs_lookup with "Hentries"). }
      destruct (entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es) as [w |] eqn:Hlookup.

      + iMod "HΦ" as "(%m & Hmodel₁ & _ & HΦ)".
        iDestruct (modelｰagree with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %->.
        assert (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∈ dom m2) as Hdom by (apply elem_of_dom; rewrite Hm; done).
        rewrite decide_True //.
        iMod ("HΦ" with "Hmodel₁") as "HΦ".
        iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
        iIntros "!> H£ Hbackoff".
        iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes") as "#Hes'".
        destruct es as [| ((key', v'), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es]; first done.
        wp۰pures.
        wp۰load.
        wp۰bind (htbl٠bucket٠assoc _ _ _)%E.
        iApply (htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspecｰbucket _ key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ((key', v', 𝑘𝑒𝑦') :: es) with "[$Hvalid_equal $Hkey $Hes']").
        iIntros "!> %node %Hnode".
        rewrite Hlookup in Hnode.
        destruct Hnode as (key'' & rest & ->).
        wp۰pures.
        rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2; first naive.
        iApply "HΦ". done.

      + iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
        iIntros "!> H£ Hbackoff".
        iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes") as "#Hes'".
        iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

        iAssert (
          WP
            𝗶𝗳 htbl٠bucket٠assoc γ.{equal} key (bucket۰to_val es.*1) != §htbl٠bucket٠Nil 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 (
              false
            ) 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 (
              𝗶𝗳
                htbl٠buckets٠cas
                  (#buckets, #(⁺(length cs) - 1), status۰to_val o)%V.<buckets> #i
                  (bucket۰to_val es.*1) ‘htbl٠bucket٠Cons[ key, v, bucket۰to_val es.*1 ]
              𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 (
                htbl٠resize γ (#buckets, #(⁺(length cs) - 1), status۰to_val o)%V #1 ⍮
                true
              ) 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 (
                htbl٠add_aux γ key v (backoff٠once backoff)
              )
            )
          {{ Φ }}
        )%I with "[Hbackoff HΦ]" as "H".
        { wp۰load.
          wp۰bind (htbl٠bucket٠assoc _ _ _)%E.
          iApply (htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspecｰbucket _ key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es with "[$Hvalid_equal $Hkey $Hes']").
          iIntros "!> %node %Hnode".
          rewrite Hlookup in Hnode. simpl in Hnode. subst node.
          wp۰pure credit:"H£".
          wp۰pures.

          awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_casｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv") without "Hbackoff"; first lia.
          iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =3)".
          iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs3 & Hgens3_lookup & Hcs3).
          iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens3_lookup.
          iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
          { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
            iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, cs3) with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
            rewrite list_insert_id //.
            iFrame "HΦ". iFrameSteps.
          }
          iIntros "%b %𝑣 (%Hlookup3 & %Hcas & Hmodel)".
          rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup3.
          apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup3 as (c & -> & Hcs3_lookup).
          simpl in Hcs3_lookup.
          destruct b.

          - apply cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰbucket in Hcas as (es3 & -> & Hes3).
            iDestruct (current۰lbｰvalid with "Hcurrent_auth Hcurrent_lb") as %Hg3.
            assert (cur1 = cur3) as <-.
            { destruct (decide (cur1 = cur3)); first done.
              opose proof* (inv۰pure۰old _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv3 cur1) as (? & ?); [lia | done | done | done].
            }
            iAssert (▷ entries۰model es3)%I as "#Hes3".
            { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens3_lookup Hcs3_lookup with "Hentries"). }
            iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes3") as "#Hes3'".
            iDestruct (entries۰modelｰagree with "Hvalid_functional Hes3' Hes'") as %->; first done.
            pose proof (inv۰pure۰model _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv3 _ Hgens3_lookup) as Hm3.
            assert (m3 !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = None) as Hm3k.
            { rewrite Hm3 /cells۰lookup /= Hcs3 (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs3_lookup) //. }
            iMod "HΦ" as "(%m & Hmodel₁ & _ & HΦ)".
            iDestruct (modelｰagree with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %->.
            iMod (modelｰupdate (<[𝑘𝑒𝑦 := v]> m3) with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as "(Hmodel₁ & Hmodel₂)".
            assert (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∉ dom m3) as Hdom by (apply not_elem_of_dom; done).
            iMod ("HΦ" with "[Hmodel₁]") as "HΦ".
            { rewrite decide_False //. }
            iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, <[i := CellActive ((key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) :: es)]> cs3) with "[Hmodel]") as "Harrays".
            { iEval (rewrite Nat2Z.id) in "Hmodel". rewrite /= list_fmap_insert //. }
            iSplitR "HΦ".
            { iModIntro. iNext.
              iExists (<[cur1 := (buckets, <[i := CellActive ((key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) :: es)]> cs3)]> gens3), cur1, resizing3, (<[𝑘𝑒𝑦 := v]> m3), F3, I3, ws3.
              rewrite (gens۰stateｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgens3_lookup); first rewrite length_insert //.
              rewrite /gens۰auth /gens۰auth' (gens۰physｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ Hgens3_lookup); first rewrite length_insert //.
              iFrame "∗#".
              iSplitR.
              { iApply (entries۰modelsｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ (CellActive ((key, v, 𝑘𝑒𝑦) :: es)) Hgens3_lookup Hcs3_lookup with "Hentries").
                rewrite /entries۰model big_sepL_cons. iFrame "#".
              }
              iSplitR.
              { iPureIntro. eapply inv۰pureｰupdate; [done | done | done | |].
                - rewrite Hcs3. split.
                  + constructor; first done. apply Hwf.
                  + apply NoDup_cons. split; last apply Hwf.
                    apply entries۰lookupｰNone. done.
                - intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦'. rewrite Hcs3.
                  destruct (decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦' = 𝑘𝑒𝑦)) as [-> | Hne].
                  + rewrite lookup_insert_eq decide_True //= decide_True //.
                  + rewrite lookup_insert_ne //.
                    case_decide as Hidx; last done.
                    rewrite /= decide_False //.
                    rewrite Hm3 /cells۰lookup Hcs3 Hidx (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs3_lookup) //.
              }
              iApply (waiter۰modelsｰmono with "Hwaiters").
              - intros g' Hg'. rewrite list_lookup_total_insert_ne //. lia.
              - apply (inv۰pure۰waiters _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv3).
            }
            iIntros "!> _ Hbackoff".

            wp۰pures.
            wp۰apply (htbl٠resizeｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hwitness]") as "_".
            wp۰pures.
            rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2 //.
            iApply "HΦ". done.

          - iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, cs3) with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
            rewrite list_insert_id //.
            iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
            iIntros "!> _ Hbackoff".

            wp۰pures.
            wp۰apply (backoff٠onceｰspec with "Hbackoff") as (backoff') "Hbackoff".
            wp۰apply ("HLöb" with "Hbackoff HΦ").
        }
        destruct es as [| ((key', v'), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es]; wp۰pures; iApply "H".

    - iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
      iIntros "!> _ Hbackoff".

      wp۰pures.
      wp۰apply (htbl٠finishｰspec with "Hhtbl") as "_".
      wp۰pures.
      wp۰rec.
      wp۰apply+ ("HLöb" with "[] HΦ").
      iApply backoff٠defaultｰspec.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma entries۰lookupｰlist_find 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es :
    entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es = None ↔
    list_find (λ 𝑘𝑒𝑦', 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es.*2 = None.
  Proof.
    rewrite entries۰lookupｰNone list_find_None Forall_forall.
    naive.
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelｰsep2 es :
    entries۰model es ⊢
    [∗ list] key'; 𝑘𝑒𝑦' ∈ es.*1.*1; es.*2,
      key۰model key' 𝑘𝑒𝑦'.
  Proof.
    rewrite /entries۰model.
    induction es as [| ((key, v), 𝑘𝑒𝑦) es IH]; first iSteps.
    rewrite big_sepL_cons /=. iIntros "($ & Hes)".
    iApply (IH with "Hes").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma entries۰modelｰdelete es k :
    entries۰model es ⊢
    entries۰model (delete k es).
  Proof.
    rewrite /entries۰model.
    iInduction es as [| e es] "IH" forall (k); first iSteps.
    iIntros "(He & Hes)".
    destruct k as [| k]; first iFrame.
    rewrite /=. iFrame.
    iApply ("IH" with "Hes").
  Qed.

  #[local] Lemma htbl٠remove_auxｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (backoff : val) :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∗
      backoff۰model backoff
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠remove_aux γ key backoff
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ (delete 𝑘𝑒𝑦 m)
    | RET #(bool_decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∈ dom m));
      True
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey & Hbackoff) HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".

    iLöb as "HLöb" forall (backoff).

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.

    wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰load.
    iDestruct (state۰witnessｰget with "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays") as "(Hgens_auth & Hcurrent_auth & Harrays & %buckets & %cap & %o & #Hwitness & _)"; first done.
    iSplitR "Hbackoff HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
    iModIntro.
    iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

    iPoseProof "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (htbl٠indexｰspec with "[$Hself_hash $Hvalid_hash $Hkey]") as "_"; first done.
    pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ltac:(lia)) as Hi.
    set i := entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
    rewrite /state۰to_val.
    wp۰pures.

    awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_getｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv") without "Hbackoff"; first lia.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =2)".
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hgens2_lookup & <-).
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens2_lookup.
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
    { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
      iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
      iSplitL "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Hmodel₂ Hself_state Hfrozen_auth Hinited_auth Hwaiters_auth Harrays Hwaiters"; last iSteps.
      iFrameSteps.
    }
    iIntros "%𝑣 (%Hlookup & Hmodel)".
    iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
    rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
    apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c & -> & Hcs_lookup).
    simpl in Hcs_lookup.
    iDestruct (current۰lbｰvalid with "Hcurrent_auth Hcurrent_lb") as %Hg.
    destruct c as [| es | es].

    - exfalso. by eapply (inv۰pureｰnot_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup Hg Hcs_lookup).

    - assert (cur1 = cur2) as <-.
      { destruct (decide (cur1 = cur2)); first done.
        opose proof* (inv۰pure۰old _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 cur1) as (? & ?); [lia | done | done | done].
      }
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰model _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ Hgens2_lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦) as Hm.
      rewrite /cells۰lookup /= (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs_lookup) /= in Hm.
      pose proof (inv۰pure۰wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ _ Hgens2_lookup _ _ Hcs_lookup) as Hwf.
      simpl in Hwf.
      iAssert (▷ entries۰model es)%I as "#Hes".
      { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup Hcs_lookup with "Hentries"). }
      destruct (entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es) as [w |] eqn:Hlookup.

      + iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
        iIntros "!> H£ Hbackoff".
        iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes") as "#Hes'".
        iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

        iAssert (
          WP
            𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵 htbl٠bucket٠dissoc γ.{equal} key (bucket۰to_val es.*1) 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵
            | None ->
                false
            | Some "new_bucket" ->
                𝗶𝗳
                  htbl٠buckets٠cas
                    (#buckets, #(⁺(length cs) - 1), status۰to_val o)%V.<buckets> #i
                    (bucket۰to_val es.*1) "new_bucket"
                𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 (
                  htbl٠resize γ (#buckets, #(⁺(length cs) - 1), status۰to_val o)%V #(-1) ⍮
                  true
                ) 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 (
                  htbl٠remove_aux γ key (backoff٠once backoff)
                )
            𝗲𝗻𝗱
          {{ Φ }}
        )%I with "[Hbackoff HΦ]" as "H".
        { wp۰load.
          wp۰bind (htbl٠bucket٠dissoc _ _ _)%E.
          iApply (htbl٠bucket٠dissocｰspec key۰model equal key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es.*1 es.*2 with "Hvalid_equal Hkey [] [Hbackoff HΦ]").
          { rewrite !length_fmap //. }
          { iModIntro. iApply (entries۰modelｰsep2 with "Hes'"). }
          destruct (list_find (λ 𝑘𝑒𝑦', 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es.*2) as [(k, 𝑘𝑒𝑦'') |] eqn:Hfind; last first.
          { apply entries۰lookupｰlist_find in Hfind. congruence. }
          apply list_find_Some in Hfind as (Hk & <- & _).
          iNext. simpl.
          rewrite -list_fmap_delete.
          wp۰pure credit:"H£".
          wp۰pures.

          awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_casｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv") without "Hbackoff"; first lia.
          iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =3)".
          iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs3 & Hgens3_lookup & Hcs3).
          iDestruct (big_sepL_insert_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens3_lookup.
          iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
          { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
            iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, cs3) with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
            rewrite list_insert_id //.
            iFrame "HΦ". iFrameSteps.
          }
          iIntros "%b %𝑣 (%Hlookup3 & %Hcas & Hmodel)".
          rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup3.
          apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup3 as (c & -> & Hcs3_lookup).
          simpl in Hcs3_lookup.
          destruct b.

          - apply cell۰to_valｰsimilarｰbucket in Hcas as (es3 & -> & Hes3).
            iDestruct (current۰lbｰvalid with "Hcurrent_auth Hcurrent_lb") as %Hg3.
            assert (cur1 = cur3) as <-.
            { destruct (decide (cur1 = cur3)); first done.
              opose proof* (inv۰pure۰old _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv3 cur1) as (? & ?); [lia | done | done | done].
            }
            iAssert (▷ entries۰model es3)%I as "#Hes3".
            { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens3_lookup Hcs3_lookup with "Hentries"). }
            iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes3") as "#Hes3'".
            iDestruct (entries۰modelｰagree with "Hvalid_functional Hes3' Hes'") as %->; first done.
            pose proof (inv۰pure۰model _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv3 _ Hgens3_lookup) as Hm3.
            assert (m3 !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦 = Some w) as Hm3k.
            { rewrite Hm3 /cells۰lookup /= Hcs3 (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs3_lookup) //. }
            iMod "HΦ" as "(%m & Hmodel₁ & _ & HΦ)".
            iDestruct (modelｰagree with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %->.
            iMod (modelｰupdate (delete 𝑘𝑒𝑦 m3) with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as "(Hmodel₁ & Hmodel₂)".
            iMod ("HΦ" with "Hmodel₁") as "HΦ".
            iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, <[i := CellActive (delete k es)]> cs3) with "[Hmodel]") as "Harrays".
            { iEval (rewrite Nat2Z.id) in "Hmodel". rewrite /= list_fmap_insert //. }
            iSplitR "HΦ".
            { iModIntro. iNext.
              iExists (<[cur1 := (buckets, <[i := CellActive (delete k es)]> cs3)]> gens3), cur1, resizing3, (delete 𝑘𝑒𝑦 m3), F3, I3, ws3.
              rewrite (gens۰stateｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgens3_lookup); first rewrite length_insert //.
              rewrite /gens۰auth /gens۰auth' (gens۰physｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ Hgens3_lookup); first rewrite length_insert //.
              iFrame "∗#".
              iSplitR.
              { iApply (entries۰modelsｰinsert _ _ _ _ _ _ (CellActive (delete k es)) Hgens3_lookup Hcs3_lookup with "Hentries").
                iApply (entries۰modelｰdelete with "Hes'").
              }
              iSplitR.
              { iPureIntro. eapply inv۰pureｰupdate; [done | done | done | |].
                - rewrite Hcs3. apply (entries۰wfｰsublist _ _ _ _ es); last done.
                  apply sublist_delete.
                - intros 𝑘𝑒𝑦'. rewrite Hcs3.
                  rewrite (entries۰lookupｰdelete 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es k); [apply Hwf | done |].
                  destruct (decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦' = 𝑘𝑒𝑦)) as [-> | Hne].
                  + rewrite lookup_delete_eq decide_True //.
                  + rewrite lookup_delete_ne //.
                    case_decide as Hidx; last done.
                    rewrite Hm3 /cells۰lookup Hcs3 Hidx (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs3_lookup) //.
              }
              iApply (waiter۰modelsｰmono with "Hwaiters").
              - intros g' Hg'. rewrite list_lookup_total_insert_ne //. lia.
              - apply (inv۰pure۰waiters _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv3).
            }
            iIntros "!> _ Hbackoff".

            wp۰pures.
            wp۰apply (htbl٠resizeｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hwitness]") as "_".
            wp۰pures.
            rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2; first (apply elem_of_dom; naive).
            iApply "HΦ". done.

          - iDestruct ("Harrays" $! (buckets, cs3) with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
            rewrite list_insert_id //.
            iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
            iIntros "!> _ Hbackoff".

            wp۰pures.
            wp۰apply (backoff٠onceｰspec with "Hbackoff") as (backoff') "Hbackoff".
            wp۰apply ("HLöb" with "Hbackoff HΦ").
        }
        destruct es as [| ((key', v'), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es]; wp۰pures; iApply "H".

      + iMod "HΦ" as "(%m & Hmodel₁ & _ & HΦ)".
        iDestruct (modelｰagree with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %->.
        assert (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∉ dom m2) as Hdom by (apply not_elem_of_dom; rewrite Hm; done).
        rewrite delete_id; first (apply not_elem_of_dom; done).
        iMod ("HΦ" with "Hmodel₁") as "HΦ".
        iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
        iIntros "!> H£ Hbackoff".
        iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£ Hes") as "#Hes'".
        iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

        iAssert (
          WP
            𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵 htbl٠bucket٠dissoc γ.{equal} key (bucket۰to_val es.*1) 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵
            | None ->
                false
            | Some "new_bucket" ->
                𝗶𝗳
                  htbl٠buckets٠cas
                    (#buckets, #(⁺(length cs) - 1), status۰to_val o)%V.<buckets> #i
                    (bucket۰to_val es.*1) "new_bucket"
                𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻 (
                  htbl٠resize γ (#buckets, #(⁺(length cs) - 1), status۰to_val o)%V #(-1) ⍮
                  true
                ) 𝗲𝗹𝘀𝗲 (
                  htbl٠remove_aux γ key (backoff٠once backoff)
                )
            𝗲𝗻𝗱
          {{ Φ }}
        )%I with "[HΦ]" as "H".
        { wp۰load.
          wp۰bind (htbl٠bucket٠dissoc _ _ _)%E.
          iApply (htbl٠bucket٠dissocｰspec key۰model equal key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 es.*1 es.*2 with "Hvalid_equal Hkey [] [HΦ]").
          { rewrite !length_fmap //. }
          { iModIntro. iApply (entries۰modelｰsep2 with "Hes'"). }
          apply entries۰lookupｰlist_find in Hlookup as ->.
          iNext. simpl.
          wp۰pures.
          rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2 //.
          iApply "HΦ". done.
        }
        destruct es as [| ((key', v'), 𝑘𝑒𝑦') es]; wp۰pures; iApply "H".

    - iSplitR "HΦ". { iFrameSteps. }
      iIntros "!> _ Hbackoff".

      wp۰pures.
      wp۰apply (htbl٠finishｰspec with "Hhtbl") as "_".
      wp۰pures.
      wp۰rec.
      wp۰apply+ ("HLöb" with "[] HΦ").
      iApply backoff٠defaultｰspec.
  Qed.


  #[local] Lemma htbl٠find_nodeｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠find_node γ key
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ m
    | node,
      RET node;
      ⌜node۰result node (m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦)⌝
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey) HΦ".
    iPoseProof "Hhtbl" as "(:inv)".
    set Ψ := (λ o, ∀ node, ⌜node۰result node o⌝ -∗ Φ node)%I.

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.

    wp۰bind (_.{state})%E.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =1)".
    wp۰load.
    iDestruct (state۰witnessｰget with "Hgens_auth Hcurrent_auth Harrays") as "(Hgens_auth & Hcurrent_auth & Harrays & %buckets & %cap & %o & #Hwitness & _)"; first done.
    iMod (saved_predｰallocｰcofinite (dom ws1) Ψ) as "(%η & %Hη & #Hη)".
    apply not_elem_of_dom in Hη.
    iMod (waitersｰinsert η (cur1, key) with "Hwaiters_auth") as "(Hwaiters_auth & Hwaiter)"; first done.
    iSplitR "Hwaiter".
    { iModIntro. iNext.
      iExists gens1, cur1, resizing1, m1, F1, I1, (<[η := (cur1, key)]> ws1).
      iFrame "∗#".
      iSplitR. { iPureIntro. apply inv۰pureｰwaitersｰinsert; done. }
      iApply big_sepM_insert; first done.
      iFrame.
      iExists 𝑘𝑒𝑦, Ψ. iFrame "#".
      rewrite decide_True //.
    }
    iModIntro.
    iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

    iPoseProof "Hwitness" as "(:state۰witness)".
    pose proof (is_pow2ｰpos _ Hpow2).
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (htbl٠indexｰspec with "[$Hself_hash $Hvalid_hash $Hkey]") as "_"; first done.
    pose proof (entries۰indexｰlt 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦 ltac:(lia)) as Hi.
    set i := entries۰index 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 cap 𝑘𝑒𝑦.
    rewrite /state۰to_val.
    wp۰pure credit:"H£1".
    wp۰pures.

    awp۰apply (array٠unsafe_getｰspecｰatomicｰinv with "Harray_inv"); first lia.
    iInv "Hinv" as "(:inv۰inner =2)".
    iDestruct (gens۰atｰvalid with "Hgens_auth Hgens_at") as %(cs & Hgens2_lookup & <-).
    iDestruct (big_sepL_lookup_acc with "Harrays") as "(Hmodel & Harrays)"; first exact Hgens2_lookup.
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel".
    { iIntros "Hmodel !>".
      iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
      iFrame "Hwaiter H£1". iFrameSteps.
    }
    iIntros "%𝑣 (%Hlookup & Hmodel)".
    rewrite difference_empty_L.
    iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£1 Hwaiters") as "Hwaiters".
    iDestruct ("Harrays" with "Hmodel") as "Harrays".
    rewrite Nat2Z.id in Hlookup.
    apply list_lookup_fmap_Some in Hlookup as (c & -> & Hcs_lookup).
    simpl in Hcs_lookup.
    iDestruct (current۰lbｰvalid with "Hcurrent_auth Hcurrent_lb") as %Hle.
    pose proof (inv۰pureｰnot_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 Hgens2_lookup Hle Hcs_lookup) as Hc.
    iDestruct (waiters۰elemｰvalid with "Hwaiters_auth Hwaiter") as %Hws2.
    iDestruct (big_sepM_delete with "Hwaiters") as "((%𝑘𝑒𝑦' & %Ψ' & #Hkey' & #Hη' & HΨ') & Hwaiters)"; first done.
    iDestruct ("Hvalid_functional" with "Hkey Hkey'") as %<-.
    iMod (waitersｰdelete with "Hwaiters_auth Hwaiter") as "Hwaiters_auth".
    set r := entries۰lookup 𝑘𝑒𝑦 (cell۰entries c).
    iAssert (|={⊤ ∖ ↑γ.(htbl۰name۰inv)}=> model₂ γ m2 ∗ Ψ' r)%I with "[HΨ' Hmodel₂]" as ">(Hmodel₂ & HΨ')".
    { simpl.
      destruct (decide (cur1 = cur2)) as [<- | Hne].
      - iMod "HΨ'" as "(%m & Hmodel₁ & _ & HΨ')".
        iDestruct (modelｰagree with "Hmodel₁ Hmodel₂") as %->.
        iMod ("HΨ'" with "Hmodel₁") as "HΨ'".
        iFrame.
        rewrite (inv۰pure۰model _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hinv2 _ Hgens2_lookup) /cells۰lookup /= (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs_lookup) //.
      - iFrame.
        rewrite (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup) /cells۰lookup /= (list_lookup_total_correct _ _ _ Hcs_lookup) //.
    }
    iAssert (▷ entries۰model (cell۰entries c))%I as "#Hes".
    { iNext. iApply (entries۰modelｰlookup _ _ _ _ _ Hgens2_lookup Hcs_lookup with "Hentries"). }
    iSplitR "HΨ'".
    { iModIntro. iNext.
      iExists gens2, cur2, resizing2, m2, F2, I2, (delete η ws2).
      iFrame "∗#".
      iPureIntro. apply inv۰pureｰwaitersｰdelete. done.
    }
    iIntros "!> H£2".
    iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£2 Hes") as "#Hes'".
    iClear "Hfrozen_elems Hentries".

    wp۰pure credit:"H£3".
    iDestruct (saved_predｰagree r with "Hη Hη'") as "Hagree".
    iMod (lc_fupd_elim_later with "H£3 Hagree") as "#Hagree'".
    iRewrite -"Hagree'" in "HΨ'".
    wp۰load.
    wp۰apply (htbl٠bucket٠assocｰspec _ key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 c with "[$Hvalid_equal $Hkey $Hes']") as (node) "%Hnode"; first done.
    iApply ("HΨ'" with "[//]").
  Qed.

  Lemma htbl۰modelｰexclusive γ m1 m2 :
    htbl۰model γ m1 -∗
    htbl۰model γ m2 -∗
    False.
  Proof.
    iIntros "Hmodel₁_1 Hmodel₁_2".
    iApply (model₁ｰexclusive with "Hmodel₁_1 Hmodel₁_2").
  Qed.

  Lemma htbl٠createｰspec ι hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 equal :
    {{{
      htbl۰valid key۰model hash 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 equal
    }}}
      htbl٠create hash equal
    {{{
      γ
    , RET γ;
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      htbl۰model γ ∅
    }}}.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hvalid_functional & #Hvalid_hash & #Hvalid_equal) HΦ".

    wp۰rec.
    rewrite htbl٠min_bucketsｰspec.
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰bind (domain٠recommended_domain_count _)%E.
    iApply domain٠recommended_domain_countｰspec. iIntros "%sz %Hsz !>".
    wp۰apply (array٠makeｰtype itype۰int with "[]") as (sizes) "(_ & #Hsizes)".
    { iSteps. }
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰apply (array٠makeｰspec with "[//]") as (t) "(_ & Hbuckets)".
    iDestruct (array۰modelｰloc with "Hbuckets") as %(buckets & ->).
    wp۰pures.
    wp۰block l as "#Hl_hash #Hl_equal #Hl_sizes Hl_state".

    iMod modelｰalloc as "(%γ_model & Hmodel₁ & Hmodel₂)".
    iMod (gensｰalloc [(buckets, replicate 16 (CellActive []))]) as "(%γ_gens & Hgens_auth)".
    iMod currentｰalloc as "(%γ_current & Hcurrent_auth)".
    iMod frozenｰalloc as "(%γ_frozen & Hfrozen_auth)".
    iMod initedｰalloc as "(%γ_inited & Hinited_auth)".
    iMod waitersｰalloc as "(%γ_waiters & Hwaiters_auth)".

    pose γ :=
      {|htbl۰name۰self := l
      ; htbl۰name۰inv := ι
      ; htbl۰name۰model := γ_model
      ; htbl۰name۰gens := γ_gens
      ; htbl۰name۰current := γ_current
      ; htbl۰name۰frozen := γ_frozen
      ; htbl۰name۰inited := γ_inited
      ; htbl۰name۰waiters := γ_waiters
      |}.

    iApply ("HΦ" $! γ).
    iSplitR "Hmodel₁"; last iFrame.
    iExists hash, 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩, equal, sizes, ₊⁺sz.
    iFrame "#".
    iSplitR; first done.
    iSplitR; first (iPureIntro; lia).
    iApply inv_alloc. iNext.
    iExists [(buckets, replicate 16 (CellActive []))], 0, false, ∅, ∅, ∅, ∅.
    rewrite /gens۰state /=.
    iFrame.
    iSplitR. { iApply big_sepM_empty. done. }
    iSplitR. { rewrite /entries۰model. iSteps. }
    iSplitR. { iPureIntro. apply (inv۰pureｰcreate 𝘩𝑎𝑠𝘩 buckets). }
    iApply big_sepM_empty. done.
    iSteps.
  Qed.

  Lemma htbl٠findｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠find γ key
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ m
    | RET m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦;
      True
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey) HΦ".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    awp۰apply (htbl٠find_nodeｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hkey]").
    iApply (aaccｰaupdｰcommit with "HΦ"); first done. iIntros "%m Hmodel".
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel"; first iSteps. iIntros "Hmodel !>".
    iFrame. iIntros "HΦ !> %node %Hnode".
    destruct (m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦) as [w |]; simpl in Hnode.

    - destruct Hnode as (k & rest & ->).
      wp۰pures.
      iApply "HΦ". done.

    - subst node.
      wp۰pures.
      iApply "HΦ". done.
  Qed.

  Lemma htbl٠memｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠mem γ key
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ m
    | RET #(bool_decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∈ dom m));
      True
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey) HΦ".

    wp۰rec. wp۰pures.
    awp۰apply (htbl٠find_nodeｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hkey]").
    iApply (aaccｰaupdｰcommit with "HΦ"); first done. iIntros "%m Hmodel".
    iAaccIntro with "Hmodel"; first iSteps. iIntros "Hmodel !>".
    iFrame. iIntros "HΦ !> %node %Hnode".
    destruct (m !! 𝑘𝑒𝑦) as [w |] eqn:Hlookup; simpl in Hnode.

    - destruct Hnode as (k & rest & ->).
      wp۰pures.
      rewrite bool_decide_eq_true_2; first (apply elem_of_dom; naive).
      iApply "HΦ". done.

    - subst node.
      wp۰pures.
      rewrite bool_decide_eq_false_2; first (apply not_elem_of_dom; done).
      iApply "HΦ". done.
  Qed.

  Lemma htbl٠addｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 v :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠add γ key v
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ (if decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∈ dom m) then m else <[𝑘𝑒𝑦 := v]> m)
    | RET #(bool_decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∉ dom m));
      True
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey) HΦ".

    wp۰rec.
    wp۰apply+ (htbl٠add_auxｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hkey] HΦ").
    iApply backoff٠defaultｰspec.
  Qed.

  Lemma htbl٠removeｰspec γ ι key 𝑘𝑒𝑦 :
    <<<
      htbl۰inv γ ι ∗
      key۰model key 𝑘𝑒𝑦
    | ∀∀ m,
      htbl۰model γ m
    >>>
      htbl٠remove γ key
      @ ↑ι
    <<<
      htbl۰model γ (delete 𝑘𝑒𝑦 m)
    | RET #(bool_decide (𝑘𝑒𝑦 ∈ dom m));
      True
    >>>.
  Proof.
    iIntros "%Φ (#Hhtbl & #Hkey) HΦ".

    wp۰rec.
    wp۰apply+ (htbl٠remove_auxｰspec with "[$Hhtbl $Hkey] HΦ").
    iApply backoff٠defaultｰspec.
  Qed.
